description.en: Master  thesis  studying  and  writing .

description.zh: 專題報告，專題演講，研究小組討論。
description.en: Seminar  report ， seminar  speech ， seminar  discussion。

description.zh: 自動化機械簡介，規劃及設計，驅動器，感測器可程式控制，氣液壓迴路控制，電腦介面控制，自動化系統實例介紹及應用。
description.en: Introduction ， design  and  planning  for  Automatic  machine ， Actuators  sensors ， PLC ， pneumatic  control ， PC - based  control ， Examples  for  Automatic  system  and  its  application .

notes: 自動化所、智慧鐵道和創新半導體合開, 計中電腦教室

description.zh: 本課程以論文研討方式學習 "機器學習" 理論之基本概念與應用及各種演算法。課程內容包含概念式學習、決策樹、圖型理論、神經網路、貝氏網路、案例式學習及支持向量機等方法。經由這門課，學生能對現代機器學習技術及其應用有基本的了解。
description.en: This is a graduate seminar-based course that provides an overview of many algorithms in machine learning and its applications. In this course, we will take an interdisciplinary look at current research topics in machine learning covering Concept Learning, Decision Tree, Graphical Model, Neural Network, Bayesian Network, Instance-based Learning, and Support Vector Machine. Through the course, students can have the basic ideas and intuition behind modern machine learning methods.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討多輸入多輸出系統 (MIMO) 其系統行為之描述，內容包括 MIMO 系統之穩定性分析、觀察性分析及其控制器設計，並探討 MIMO 系統的物理觀念及其數學描述的各種方法，是線性系統之進階課程，適合碩士班以上之學生學習。
description.en: The main objective of this course is to explore the behaviors of multivariable systems. The contents includes: stability analysis, observability analysis, and controller designs for MIMO linear systems. Besides, we will introduce the physical concept of MMIO linear systems and various methods of describing MIMO linear systems via mathematical model. This is an advanced course to linear system theory, and is especially for graduate students.

notes: 自動化所和機電博 (外生) 班合開

description.zh: 本課程主要探討非線性系統與線性系統之間的不同，並介紹 Lyapunov stability 及其相關觀念。除此之外，將介紹如何利用各種穩定性分析的觀念及各種方法探討非線性系統的穩定性，最後並介紹如何設計控制器使非線性系統穩定。
description.en: This course mainly explores the different between the nonlinear system and linear system, and introduces the concept Lyapunov stability. Besides, one wants to introduce how to utilize the concept and method of stability analysis to explore the stability of nonlinear system. Finally, the designs of nonlinear controllers are introduced to stabilize the nonlinear systems.

description.zh: 本課程以講授工業用計算機網路中實體層、媒體存取控制與邏輯連結層為主。在實體層中，將討論到目前廣泛於工業上使用的實體媒介。在媒體存取控制上，則討論乙太網路，記號匯流排與記號環網路為主。媒體存取控制也包含目前廣泛於各類控制器上使用的控制區域網路 (CAN Bus)。在邏輯連結層上，主要討論路由器使用的路由協定與路由演算法。
description.en: The main subjects of this course include physical layer, media access control and logic link layer. Popular physical layer medium are discussed first. Media access control sub-layer that includes Ether-Net, Token Bus and Token Ring are the main subjects in the second portion. The contents of the media access control also include CAN bus which is widely used in various controllers. Routing protocol used by routers are discussed in third portion of this course.

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。   真空工程, 直流電源, 射頻電源, 微波, 熱燈絲等各種能量方式之 CVD 化學氣相沉積法, PVD 物理氣相沉積法, 電鍍技術, 以及膜的特性觀察與實驗，包括 SEM，EDX，XRD 與金相顯微觀察，附著力測試等。1. 光電半導體 V - I 特性分析試驗 2. 接面型光電元件 C - V 量測實驗 3. 光導電及少數載體存活時間量測實驗 4. 邁克蓀干涉儀實驗 (3) 5. 雷射繞射實驗 (3) 6. 偏振實驗 (3) 7. 分光儀實驗 (3)
description.en: The practices in vacuum engineering, variety deposition methods such as CVD, PVD and electroplating, that include DC, RF, microwave hot filament etc are be performed. Tests of film properties and its characterizations such as SEM, EDX, XRD, and metallurgical microscope are also be examined.1.Experiment on V-I characteristics of photonic devices.2.C-V measurements of optoelectronic devices.3.Measurements of photoconductivity and minority-carrier lifetime of photonic materials.4.Lab on Michelson interferometer5.Lab Experiment on diffraction 6.Lab on polarization7.Lab on spectrometer

description.zh: 修先課程：光學。 本課程利用傅氏轉換理論解釋繞射理論及光影像處理與光資訊處理技術，它包含：1. 簡介 2. 二維線性系統分析 3. 繞射理論 4. 近場及遠場繞射 5. 透鏡之傅氏轉換與影像品質分析 6. 影像系統之頻域分析 7. 空間濾波與光資訊處理 8. 全像
description.en: This course illustrates the diffraction theory and techniques of image processing and optical information processing by using the methods of Fourier transform. It involves：1. Introduction2.Analysis of 2-D linear systems3.Diffraction theory 4.Fresnel and Fraunhofer diffraction5.Fourier transforming6.Frequency analysis of optical imaging properties of lenses 7.Spatial filtering and optical information processing8.Holography

description.zh: 先修課程：近代光學。   1. 基本分析工具介紹 (6) 2. 基本光學系統 --- 近軸光學 (6) 3. 光學系統元件介紹 (6) 4. 像差理論 (6) 5. 像質評估 (6) 6. 光學系統設計 (6) 7. 光學套裝軟體使用 (6) 8. 光電設計專題 (9)
description.en: 1.The tools 2.The basic optical systems 3.Basic optical devices 4.Seidel aberrations  5.Image evaluation 6.The design of optical systems 7.The use of Zemax 8.Project on optical design

notes: 光電四、光電所和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 1. 光纖通訊系統介紹 2. 光纖種類及特性 3. 訊號的退化 4. 發光器 5. 接收器 6. 中繼站及光放大器 7. 數位傳輸系統 8. 光固子及 DWDM 系統
description.en: 1.Introduction to optical fiber communications.2.Optical fibers-losses and fabrications3.Signal degradation4.Light emitters5.Optical receivers6.Repeaters and optical amplifier7.Digital communications8.Solitions and dense wavelength-division multiplexing   tgdi systems

description.zh: 1. 幾何光學 2. 波動光學 3. 光束光學 4. 傅氏光學 5. 光電磁學 6. 偏極光學與晶體光學
description.en: 1. Ray Optics2. Wave Optics3. Beam Optics4. Fourier Optics5. Electromagnetic Optics6. Polarization and Crystal Optics

description.zh: 本課程介紹固體，尤其是半導體的光學性質，目的在了解光學檢測及光電元件的基礎原理。 藉由學習電磁波與半導體的交互作用，一方面可了解光在半導體中的產生、傳播、吸收、散射、及在界面的透射與反射等現象的規律，另一方面亦可認識光學特性與能帶結構、聲子結構、束縛與自由電子、及各種激發態之間的關係。課程內容包含固態物理複習、光學特性簡介、古典模型、帶間躍遷、激子、螢光現象、半導體低維系統的光學性質、自由載子及缺陷的光學性質、聲子相關特性、非線性光學性質等。
description.en: This course introduces the optical properties of solids, mainly semiconductors. The fundamental principles of absorption, reflection, luminescence and light scattering will be illustrated in terms of classical and quantum theories as appropriate. It mainly includes (1) Introduction (2) Classical propagation (3) Interband absorption (4) Excitons (5) Luminescence (6) Low-dimensional systems of semiconductors (7) Free electrons (8) Luminescence centers (9) Phonons (10)Nonlinear properties.

description.zh: 1. 光感測技術概論、2. 光感測元件、3. 光源與光偵測元件、4. 光感測系統設計與架構、5. 光感測訊號處理技術、6. 光感測訊號分類與辨識、7. 光感測系統校正與穩定性提升、8. 光感測應用案例分析。
description.en: 1. Introduction to Optical Sensing Technologies2. Optical Sensing Devices3. Light Sources and Photodetectors4. Design and Architecture of Optical Sensing Systems5. Signal Processing Techniques for Optical Sensing6. Classification and Recognition of Optical Sensing Signals7. Calibration and Stability Enhancement of Optical Sensing Systems  8. Case Studies in Optical Sensing Applications

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於具應用潛力之前瞻光電材料之性質、製程技術，以及其於光學檢測與雷射應用中的角色。涵蓋之材料類型包括光電半導體材料（如 III - V 族、鈣鈦礦）、液晶、有機高分子材料、奈米材料（如金屬奈米粒子）與二維材料（如石墨烯、MXene 等）。學生將深入了解這些材料的光電特性，並探討其在雷射、感測器、顯示器、可撓式電子與生醫檢測元件等領域的實際應用。課程內容亦介紹多種光學與雷射相關的量測技術，包括光學吸收、螢光、光致發光（PL）、拉曼光譜、表面增強拉曼散射（SERS），以及雷射激發之光學檢測方法。透過應用導向的案例分析與實作設計，強化學生於材料、雷射與光學系統整合方面的跨領域實務能力。
description.en: This course focuses on the properties and fabrication techniques of advanced optoelectronic materials, as well as their roles in optical detection and laser-related applications.Covered material categories include optoelectronic semiconductors,liquid crystals, organic polymers and biocompatible materials.Students will gain in-depth understanding of the optoelectronic properties of these materials and explore their practical applications in laser systems,sensors,displays,flexible electronics,and biomedical diagnostic devices.The course also introduces a variety of optical and laser-based characterization techniques,including optical absorption,fluorescence,photoluminescence,Raman spectroscopy,surface-enhanced Raman scattering,and laser-excited optical detection methods.Through application-oriented case studies and hands-on project design, students will develop interdisciplinary practical skills in integrating materials, lasers, and optical systems.

name.zh: 前瞻材料光學量測與應用
name.en: Optical Measurement and Applications of Emerging Materials

description.zh: 1. 有機電子元件導論。2. 材料導論與晶體結構。3. 有機半導體光學特性。4. 有機半導體電學特性。5. 有機發光二極體。6. 有機太陽能電池與光偵測器。7. 有機場效電晶體。8. 有機半導體製程
description.en: 1.	Introduction to Organic Electronic Devices2.	Introduction to Materials and Crystal Structures3.	Optical Properties of Organic Semiconductors4.	Electrical Properties of Organic Semiconductors5.	Organic Light-Emitting Diodes (OLEDs)6.	Organic Solar Cells and Photodetectors7.	Organic Field-Effect Transistors (OFETs)8.	Organic Semiconductor Fabrication Processes

name.zh: 有機半導體材料與元件導論
name.en: Introduction to Organic Semiconductor Materials and Devices

description.zh: 邀請校內外學者專家至校針對某一專長領域進行專題演講，讓學生藉由聽講及心得報告之寫作，開展視野，並與時代之脈動相契合。
description.en: Invited speakers from different disciplines give speech in their specialized area. Thus students can broaden their eyesight and also keep updating the technology and its applications of the generation.

notes: 限生化碩選課, 和博班生化組合開

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作﹐包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段﹐避免口語用字寫字的陋習﹐使所作之文章能掌握其涵意﹐亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Thesis Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

description.zh: 本課程將涵蓋以下幾項範圍：染色体結構, DNA 複製與轉錄, 蛋白質結構、功能、輸送、合成與分解、真核與原核細胞基因調控、分子發育學、跳躍基因、癌症與免疫生物學等。並引導學生探討幾個相關分子生物化學較深入的知識。包括: 蛋白質接受器、生物膜、生物代謝和基因調控、人類疾病的生物化學及分子生物和生物技術。
description.en: Lectures are concerned with number of selected topics in molecular biochemistry.: structure and coding capacity of DNA chromosomes; DNA replication; transcription, protein synthesis; protein structure and function; protein transport; protein degradation; receptors; biological membranes; prokaryotic and eukaryotic regulation; metabolic and genetic regulation; transposable elements and genetic engineering; cancer and immunobiology, biochemistry of human diseases and the techniques that underpin the developments of molecular biology and biotechnology.

description.zh: 此課程包含幾大方向： 1.	醫工簡介 2.	常用之醫學材料 甲、	金屬 乙、	高分子 丙、	陶瓷 3.	奈米技術 4.	材料測試 甲、	物理 / 機械測試 乙、	細胞測試
description.en: The content of the lecture includes:1.Introduction to biomedical engineering2.commonly used medical materials: metals, polymers, ceramic3.nano-technology4.materials testing: physical/mechanical tests,iocompatibility tests

description.zh: 本課程是介紹基因工程學之基礎知識。內容包括寄主細胞的選擇：細菌、酵母菌、真菌等微生物或昆蟲細胞、哺乳類動物細胞等動物細胞或者是植物細胞。聚合連鎖反應、基因轉殖、質體轉型、病毒轉換、基因槍等常用的基因工程學之方法。
description.en: This course is to introduce basic knowledge of genetic engineering, including the selection of host cells, bacterial, yeast, fungi, insect cell, mammalian cell, or plant cell. The powerful methods of genetic engineering, including polymerase chain reaction (PCR), gene clone, plasmid transformation, virus transduction, and biolistics are also introduced in this course.

description.zh: 邀請校內外學者專家至校針對某一專長領域進行專題演講，讓學生藉由聽講及心得報告之寫作，開展視野，並與時代之脈動相契合。(在職專班)
description.en: Invited speakers from different disciplines give speech in their specialized area. Thus students can broaden their eyesight and also keep updating the technology and its applications of the generation.

notes: 限化工碩選課, 和博班化工組合開

description.zh: 介紹高分子分子結構、型態學、流變學、化學性質、熱性質、機械、電學及光學等特性之分析方法及實例。
description.en: This course will cover the examples of analysis of the mechanical, thermal, electrical, optical and chemical properties, and the structure, morphology, and rheology of polymers.

name.en: Special Topics on Characteristics of Polymers

notes: EMI 網路預選限 50 人

description.zh: 本課程介紹近代電化學的分析方法。 介紹內容包含電位法、循環伏安法、安培法、光譜電化學法、旋轉環碟電極法、及其他近代電化學的分析方法。
description.en: Introduction the principles and applications of modern electroanalytical methods. Introduction the theory and application of polarography, potentiometry, cyclic voltammetry, Amperometry, spectroelectrochemistry, RRDE, and other modern electroanalytical techniques.

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材 (富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料 (二硫化鉬與金屬化) 等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

notes: 先鋒教室; 化工所和創新半導體合開; 網路預選限 25 人

description.zh: 課程兩個主要目標為光譜學方法及分離方法。光譜學方法內容含紫外、可見、紅光、核磁、x-ray 等光譜法。電子譜及質譜也將被討論。分離方法方面有液層、氣層、膠層等層析法。分離後串聯之光譜分析也會學習。
description.en: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.

class.name: 能源光電外國學生專班

notes: 化學館 207；化工所和 EOMP 合開

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。

description.zh: 1.X 光之本質 2. 晶体幾何及倒置晶格 3. 晶體立體投影 4.X 光繞射原理 5.X 光繞射實驗方法 (繞射儀，Laue 照相法，粉末法) 6.X 光繞射之應用 (包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等)
description.en: 1.Properties of X-Ray 2.Crystallography and Reciprocal Lattice 3.Projections of Crystals 4.Principles of X-Ray Diffraction 5.Experimental Methods (Diffractometer Methods, Powder Photographs and Laue Pholtographs)6.Applications of X-ray Diffraction (Orientation and Quality of Single Crystal,  Structure of Polycrystalline Aggregates, Determine of Crystal Structure and Precise Parameter Measurements, Chemical Analysis, Phase Transformations etc.)

description.en: The contents include elastic and plastic deformation in materials，dislocations，high temperature deformation，tensile fracture at low temperature，high temperature fracture and fatigue。

description.zh: 本課程將結合理論說明與示範實習，使同學對雷射基本原理及光電科技應用有一完整的認識，內容包括：1. 光電工程概論，2. 基礎光學，3. 電射發光原理，4. 雷射光的調製，5. 光電科技應用概論。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Photo- Electronic Materials.

description.zh: 1. 陶瓷絕緣體之性質 2. 陶瓷電容材料 3. 壓電及光電陶瓷 4. 磁性陶瓷 5. 陶瓷感應器：理論及實務 6. ZnO 變阻器之應用及特性 7. 多層陶瓷技術 8. 高電導陶瓷
description.en: This course is a special topics of Dielectrical Materials.

description.zh: 1. 合金製程簡介 2. 成份改變製程　a. 合金熔煉 - 感應電爐、真空感應電爐  b. 合金精煉 - 電弧爐、  c. 電渣重熔精煉、真空電弧精煉、電子束精煉、電漿精煉 3. 合金結構改變製程　a. 凝固控製與快速凝固　　b. 方向性凝固　　　　　c. 熱處理控制 - 均質化、強化處理　　d. 鍛造、晶粒控制　　　　　　　4. 合金形狀改重製程鍛造、軋壓、擠形、粉末冶金 5. 未來合金製程之發展及電腦之應用
description.en: This course is a special topics of  Processes of Structural Alloys.

description.zh: 1. 簡介 2. 視覺與色彩 3. 陰極射線管顯示器 4. 電漿顯示器 5. 液晶顯示器 6. 電致發光顯示器 7. 場發射顯示器 8. 有機發光顯示器
description.en: Introduction of the theories and technologies of flat panel display and the future development of flat display technology.  1.Introduction 2.Sight and color 3.Cathode-ray tube(CRT) 4.Plasma panel display(PDP) 5.Liquid crystal display(LCD) 6.Electrolumisence display(ELP) 7.Field emission display(FED) 8.Organic light emitting device(OLED)

name.zh: 平面顯示器原理與技術
name.en: Principle of Flat Panel Display Technology

description.zh: 本課程內容含有: (1) 簡介。(2) 貯氫合金種類 (3) 貯氫合金結構與性質 (4) 貯氫合金製程 --- 機械冶金 (5) 貯氫合金製程 --- 真空感應熔煉 (6) 貯氫材料之吸放氫測量方法 (7) 貯氫合金應用 (8) 鎳氫電池材料 (9) 奈米碳材之結構與性質 (10) 奈米碳材之製程 (11) 奈米碳材之應用 (12) 氫燃料電池 --- 質子交換膜材料 (13) 氫燃料電池 --- 膜電極組材料
description.en: The class includes :1.Course Introduction, 2.Classes of Hydrogen Storage Alloys (HSAs),3. Structure and Properties of HSAs,4. Production of HSAs ---Mechanical Alloying Process,5.,roduction of HSAs ---Vacuum Induction Melting (VIM) Process,6.. Method of Measuring Storage Capacity for Hydrogen Storage Materials,7. Application of HSAs,8. Materials of Nickel Hydride Battery Electrode,9. Structure and Properties of Carbon Nano Tubes (CNTs), 10. Production of CNTs, 11. Application of CNTs,12. Hydrogen Fuel Cell ---Proton Exchange Membrane, 13 Hydrogen Fuel Cell ---Membrane Electrode Assembly (MEA)

description.zh: 國際合作專題特論乃透過國際大師的講課，讓學生學習材料科學或資源工程相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application in the materials science and mineral engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.

description.zh: 課程內容包含鍍膜材料科學，真空科學與技術，鍍膜蒸鍍製程，放電、電漿、離子與表面作用，物理氣相沈積，化學氣相沈積，基材表面與鍍膜成核，鍍膜結構，鍍膜性質測試，鍍膜之相互擴散、反應與轉換，鍍膜之機械性質。
description.en: This course discusses: 1. Coating film materials science 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Coating film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of coating films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and coating film nucleation 8. Coating Film structure 9. Characterization of coating films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in coating films 11. Mechanical properties of coating films.

name.en: Introduction to Coating Processes Engineering and Application

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

description.zh: 1.X 光之本質 2. 晶体幾何及倒置晶格 3. 晶體立體投影 4.X 光繞射原理 5.X 光繞射實驗方法 (繞射儀，Laue 照相法，粉末法) 6.X 光繞射之應用 (包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等)
description.en: 1.Properties of X-Ray 2.Crystallography and Reciprocal Lattice 3.Projections of Crystals 4.Principles of X-Ray Diffraction 5.Experimental Methods (Diffractometer Methods, Powder Photographs and Laue Pholtographs)6.Applications of X-ray Diffraction (Orientation and Quality of Single Crystal,  Structure of Polycrystalline Aggregates, Determine of Crystal Structure and Precise Parameter Measurements, Chemical Analysis, Phase Transformations etc.)

description.zh: 本課程將介紹界面活性劑的種類及其化學製程、界面活性劑於界面之吸附現象、微胞形成原理與應用、表面改質技術、發泡劑的應用等。
description.en: This course will introduce (1)characteristic features of surfactant and its preparation (2)adsorption of surface-active agents at interfaces (3)micelle formation by surfactants (4)modification of surface properties by surfactants (5)foaming and antifoaming by aqueous solutions of surfactants.

name.zh: 界面活性劑原理與應用
name.en: The Principles and Applications of Surface Active Agent

description.zh: 地質災害調查分析課程將介紹地震、山崩、滑坡、地破、地縫等災害的發生原因及其調查分析方法，包括地質調查、工程地質勘查、地球物理探測和遙感技術等方面。課程內容還包括地質災害預防與治理方法等方面。
description.en: This course will introduce the causes and investigation and analysis methods of geological disasters such as earthquakes, landslides, rockfalls, ground fissures, and soil subsidence. It includes geological survey, engineering geological exploration, geophysical exploration, and remote sensing technology. The course also covers prevention and control methods of geological hazards.

description.zh: 資源工程導論為資源工程的入門學科，其範圍包括天然的金屬、非金屬、礦物與石油、天然氣、建築用砂石、石材與水等原生資源，以及工商業及一般生活的廢棄物或其附帶產生的可再生資源。期對初學者有一整體的基本概念。
description.en: This is a general introduction class to provide student basic knowledge about resources engineering which include metal, nonmetal, minerals, petroleum, natural gas, aggregates, dimension stone and water resources.

description.zh: 本課程重點在於台灣專利法的主要法律議題，包括產業利用性、新穎性、進步性、可實施性、說明書支持性、請求項不明確性、請求項解釋、侵權行為、救濟手段、專利授權、強制授權、專利訴訟之展開和舉發。本課程教材包括專利法教科書、智慧局頒發的專利審查基準和智慧財產法院裁判。
description.en: This course focuses on the main legal issues of the Taiwan Patent Law including industrial utility, novelty, inventive step, enablement, written description, claim indefiniteness, claim interpretation, infringement, remedies, patent licensing, compulsory licensing, initiation of patent litigation, and opposition. The class materials include a patent law textbook, patent examination guidelines issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office and recent decisions from the Taiwan Intellectual Property Court.

description.zh: 為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展，國家特制定商標法，本課程以介紹我國商標法為重點，主要內容包括商標規範之基本原理、商標之構成要素、商標之分類方式及各類型商標之特性與功能、申請商標註冊之程序、商標註冊之審查及核准、商標權之取得及行使、異議程序及紛爭處理、權利侵害之救濟等。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and the consumers' interest, maintain fair competition of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. This course is focusing on the introduction of Trademark Act. Topics will mainly include the basic principle of trademark standard, the integrant part of trademark, the characteristic and the function of trademark, the application procedures, examination and approval, acquisition of the trademark rights and exercises, the procedure of opposition and the dispute processes, remedies for right infringement and so on.

description.zh: 於高科技、知識經濟時代，作為無形資產之「全球品牌」，已成為促進公司價值及成長之引擎。此全球品牌大時代氛圍，「全球品牌」策略愈發重要。品牌策略管理在提供客戶認知、產品績效及企業價值。藉由品牌溝通，品牌創造客戶對品牌之熟悉及偏好，而達成商業管理目標，進而提昇股東價值及股價市值。本課程將就下列議題及知名品牌運作模式為說明：一、品牌發展策略，二、品牌價值，三、品牌商標保護策略 (即 1. 商標計畫，2. 商標執行，3. 商標控制）。四、公司治理與品牌管理。五、智財品牌授權。
description.en: In High-tech knowledge economy, as intangible assets "global brand", has become an engine for raising company value. During this global brand era, "global brand" strategy is important for enhancing customer awareness and business performance.  Through diversified brand communication, global brand creates customer familiarity and preference, and to achieve business goals, thereby enhancing shareholder value.The course focuses on the following topics: First, the brand development strategy, Second, brand value, Third, brand & trademark protection strategy. Fourth, corporate governance and brand management. .Fifth, intellectual property/brand licensing.

name.en: Intellectual Property Management for Global Brands

notes: 新聘專任教師; 英文授課

description.zh: 本課程上學期將以智慧財產局頒佈之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程式後實體」原則先就「程式審查」部分介紹專利申請之程式，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (I)

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際醫材產品或相關技術，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書 (含申請專利範圍) 撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: This course focuses on the procedural aspects of the patent prosecution in biomedical materials/devices. The topics cover patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and office action response. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies are also discussed in class.

name.en: Practice in Biomedical Materials/Devices Patent Application

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法，培養學生撰寫論文的基本知識與能力。
description.en: This course will introduce research methods and provide students with fundamental knowledge and competence on writing thesis.

description.zh: 探索古代生活中重要的文化主題，尤其是恬適快意又發顯美感訊息的生活內容與活動模式，這滲透著義涵與美感的主題，歷經翻檢淘洗終被標舉揭櫫，即是本課程著意介述、體驗、評論的元素。「美學」是以對美的本質及其意義的研究為主題的科學，「文化學」研究文化現象或文化體系，「審美文化」則以其特有形態來彌補「道」、「器」間的距離，以實物印證觀念，用觀念史來概括和昇華物態。「文化生活美學」在相關的三者間另闢新徑，取材傾向生活行為方式及活動內容，探索理解與感受，結合「意義的貞定」、「美感領受的追求與實現」，以古典中國文士階層的開發為主力，擴及君王貴族及民間百姓的留存。本課程分為二部，前者宏觀文化變遷現象及其架構成因，其次，梳理古來時節風尚，人文藝術的脈絡，廣泛取材於文學、思想、器物、禮制、用香、茶藝等生活美學內容，回溯、體驗、評論，而體驗經濟模式的企劃，正是為「文化生活產業化」預做準備。
description.en: Life Aesthetics is the kernel of cultural life; it has become integral in the process toward cultural industrialization and industrial culturalization. In fact, "creative industries" may be connected to various sectors of developments and has become a prospect eagerly and aggressively pursued by visionary people, especially in the wake of Chinese economic expansion.This course will examine the important elements constituting cultural lives across different dynasties in Chinese history and investigate their patterns of presentations. The beauty of traditional behavioral culture, the significance of solar terms and seasonal festivals, and the implications of cultural concerns can serve as sources, based on which students' creativity be stimulated and further brought into full play.

name.zh: 文化生活美學發展專題
name.en: Seminars on the Aesthetics of Life

description.zh: 本課程分為兩大部分，其一為理論和議題的探究，自文化資產概念出發，探究文資保存範疇下的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現、資源管理和應用；其二為講授文化資產資源應用所需的研究方法和工具－田野調查；同時透過國內外文化資產的案例作分析與討論，深度檢視文化資產的多元面貌。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of heritage from the context of Taiwan and UNESCO. Different issues related to heritage preservation are discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of tangible and intangible heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture and history, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. Moreover, fieldwork, the research methods of doing heritage preservation and resource management is also taught in this course. Finally, international case studies of heritage reuse and management are examined, to understand different ways of heritage practice.

name.zh: 文化資產保存理論與資源應用

description.zh: 本課程旨在訓練學生開拓新的視野，蒐集、分析口述歷史資料並進行一份口述作品。課程將採實作練習與理論兼顧，全面分析整理台灣學界與非學界口述訪談之成果，檢視口述歷史訪談方法、口述紀錄出版品與各種延伸加值運用：紀錄片、電影、漫畫、文史書籍以及其他形式的智慧財產（IP）。
description.en: This course aims to broaden students' perspectives and equip them with the skills to collect and analyze oral history recordings, and produce an oral history project. It will combine practical exercises with theoretical learning and provide a comprehensive analysis of oral interviews conducted by both academic and non-academic institutions in Taiwan. The course will examine oral history interview methods, oral record transcriptions/recordings, and various extended applications of oral history materials, including documentaries, films, comics, literary and historical books, and other intellectual property (IP) projects.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹企業的管理系統如何有效的計畫、設計和分析及實行，包括管理系統的分析、可行性研究、系統設計、系統發展、雛形設計、測試、文件製作和評估等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide the students with a broad understanding of information systems, information technologies, information systems development and management in business and other organizations.

description.zh: 本課程主要闡述財務管理中最重要的投資決策、融資決策與短期資金管理決策之基本架構及企業經理人之財務決策，配合各項相關議題進行個案研討，結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹財務管理之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務管理的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的融資與投資決策制定。課程內容涵蓋：金融市場與金融機構、財務報表與現金流量分析、財務規劃與預測、風險與報酬、債券與股票之評價、資金成本、資本預算決策、資本結構與財務槓桿、營運資金管理、股利政策… 等。本課程結合財務管理實務並融入財務決策研討，以培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才。透過本課程之修習，期許學生能具備財務管理領域之學科知識與專業技術整合能力、獨立研究之能力、判斷性思考與決策能力，以及制訂並解決財務管理問題之能力。
description.en: The course focus on the three most important decisions of the financial management: the investment decisions, the financing decisions and short-term capital management and financial decisions of corporate managers, and various related topics with case studies. This course combines information and software tools to use; the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics including: Financial markets and financial institutions, the financial statements and cash flow analysis, financial planning and forecasting, risk and return, bond and stock pricing, the cost of capital, capital budgeting decisions, capital structure and financial leverage, working capital management, dividend policy, mergers and acquisitions, etc. This course combines b

description.zh: 針對學生之學習研究心得報告，集體討論，以訓練學生研究之能力。
description.en: This seminar focuses on report writing of research, group study, and training of students' research ability.

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

notes: 資財四甲、資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 來自於內部與外部的攻擊使企業在系統及網路保護遭遇許多挑戰，為了有效控制企業風險，政府在內部控制相關法規明確要求資訊系統相關的內部控制，而電腦稽核為確保內部控制的關鍵角色。本課程內容以國際電腦稽核師 (CISA) 認證的各項領域內容為主。期望學生能夠對於瞭解資訊系統稽核及其風險管理相關概念有初步的瞭解，進而瞭解資訊安全及資訊系統稽核的機制與手法，作為協助學生順利考取國際電腦稽核師 (CISA) 認證碁石。
description.en: Internal and external attacks have caused enterprises to encounter many challenges in system and network protection. In order to effectively control enterprise risks, the government's accounting regulations explicitly require information system-related internal controls, and computer audit is a key role for ensuring internal control. The content of this course is based on the content of various fields of the International Computer Auditor (CISA) certification. Students are expected to have a preliminary understanding of the information system audit and its risk management related concepts, and then understand the mechanisms and techniques of information security and information system auditing. Finally, it is expected as a way to help students successfully obtain the CISA certification.

notes: 資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於如何應用計量方法來進行財金議題之研究，課程內容包括縱斷面資料分析、橫斷面資料分析、追蹤資料分析、以及多變量時間序列分析等，讓學生掌握有助於分析經濟和金融數據的計量經濟學學習方法的知識，培養同學具有應用計量軟體進行分析研究的能力。
description.en: The course is aimed to provide essential econometric methods and their application to research issues. Topics cover regression analysis using time-series data, cross-sectional data, and panel data. The multivariate time-series analysis is also introduced in the course. This course is designed to prepare students with knowledge of econometric methods that are useful for analyzing economic and financial data. Students will focus on learning econometric software skills in estimating and analyzing econometric models.

description.zh: 雲端 (Cloud) 與物聯網 (Internet of Things, IoT) 重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

notes: 資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

notes: 資財四甲和資財所合開 / 哈佛講堂

description.zh: 隨著金融交易、機器人應用等網路應用快速成長，系統需同時具備高擴展性、可靠性與安全性。為因應此趨勢，本課程培養學生具備從應用層到作業系統核心的程式開發實力，並強調 TCP / IP 通訊與系統架構整合。
description.en: With the rapid growth of internet services—such as financial transactions and robotic applications—modern systems must be scalable, reliable, and secure. This course addresses these needs by training students in programming skills from the application layer to the OS kernel, emphasizing TCP/IP networking and system architecture.

name.zh: 網路系統程式開發與安全

notes: 資財四甲、資財所和創新資安合開 / 全英語

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct  multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation. The teachin

name.en: Special Topics on Interactive Media Design (I)

notes: 排一般教室, 限本系生修課, 人數上限 25 人

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在人機互動設計中的運算思維與解決問題的能力。課程將針對設計背景學生在學習程式設計時的挑戰，藉由多階段的教學設計與工具輔助，降低程式學習門檻，促進學生跨領域整合能力，並提升其在設計與技術跨領域的創新實作能力。課程具體涵蓋以下教學目標: 1. 促進運算思維能力與邏輯推理能力的發展 2. 提升學生學習程式設計之動機與自信心 3. 促進跨領域知識整合與應用能力 4. 提升學習動機與創新實作能力
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' computational thinking and problem-solving skills in human-computer interaction design. It primarily targets students without an information technology background and addresses the challenges faced by design-background students in learning programming. Through multi-stage teaching design and tool assistance, the course reduces the barriers to programming learning, promotes cross-disciplinary integration, and enhances students' innovative implementation abilities in the intersection of design and technology. The course specifically covers the following objectives:1. Promote the development of computational thinking and logical reasoning abilities 2. Enhance students' motivation and confidence in learning programming 3. Facilitate cross-disciplinary knowledge integration and application 4. Boost learning motivation and innovative implementation abilities

name.zh: 人機互動設計與技術實作
name.en: Human-Computer Interaction Design and Technical Practice

notes: 排 PBL 教室, 限 30 人 (大四生可上修)

description.zh: 隨著生成式 AI 與大型語言模型迅速融入設計流程與數位產品開發，互動設計者需具備整合 AI 技術與人機介面設計的跨域素養。本課程旨在探討人工智慧技術於人機互動設計中的應用，培養學生設計與開發智慧互動系統的核心能力。課程內容涵蓋人機互動及互動設計之基本概念、語意理解與回應機制、以及 AI 驅動之使用者體驗創新。教學上將透過講述法和工作坊建立基礎觀念，搭配上機實作強化技術操作能力，並以專題導向學習形式，引導學生完成從構思到原型開發之完整設計流程。
description.en: As generative AI and large language models (LLMs) reshape design processes, interaction designers must integrate AI technologies with human-computer interface design to enhance the user experience. This course explores the application of AI in human-computer interaction (HCI), focusing on essential skills for developing intelligent interactive systems. Topics include HCI fundamentals, semantic understanding and response mechanisms, and AI-driven innovations in user experience. Lectures build theoretical foundations, hands-on practice strengthens technical skills, and project-based learning guides students from ideation to prototyping.

notes: 互動三和互動所合開, 排先鋒 PBL 教室, 限 25 人修, 自備筆電

description.zh: 本課程探討太空任務的設計和實施，以實現太空任務目標。本課程涵蓋，太空任務的目標、設計流程、系統工程原理、燃料和動力系統、通訊和導航系統、太空運輸系統、生命維持系統、太空裝備和儀器、以及太空任務的管理和財務考慮因素。
description.en: This course discusses the design and implementation of space missions to achieve their goals. The course covers the goals of space missions, design processes, principles of systems engineering, fuel and propulsion systems, communication and navigation systems, space transportation systems, life support systems, space equipment and instruments, as well as management and financial considerations for space missions.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

notes: 光電四、光電所選修和太空所必修合開、億光 405 教

description.zh: 1.	衛星軌道與軌跡 2.	數位通訊，多工技術 3.	衛星通訊 - 衛星本體 4.	衛星通訊 - 地面站 5.	衛星鏈路分析與設計 6.	衛星通訊應用

description.zh: 「太空軟體系統設計」課程旨在培養學生在太空任務中設計、開發和操作軟體系統的專業能力。學生將深入了解太空環境對軟體系統的特殊要求，包括真空、輻射、溫度等因素對系統性能的影響。課程將探討飛行軟體的設計和架構，學生將學習如何設計出能夠在極端條件下穩定運行的飛行軟體系統，確保太空任務的順利執行。此外，課程將涵蓋軟體驗證和確認技術，學生將學習如何確保軟體系統的功能性和安全性，並掌握各種測試方法和工具的應用。課程還將關注容錯和自我修復能力的設計，學生將學習如何設計具有容錯和自我修復功能的軟體系統，以應對可能的故障情況。最後，課程將介紹太空軟體系統的專案管理和實施，學生將學習如何有效地管理軟體開發專案，確保項目按時交付並符合品質標準。此外，課程還將包括深度學習在太空軟體系統中的應用，學生將探索如何利用深度學習技術來改進太空任務中的軟體系統設計和性能，以及酬載資料處理軟體的設計和開發，以支援太空任務中的資料收集和分析。通過本課程的學習，學生將具備設計和開發太空軟體系統所需的技能和知識，為未來在太空工程或相關領域的工作做好準備。
description.en: The course "Space Software System Design" aims to cultivate students' professional abilities in designing, developing, and operating software systems for space missions. Students will gain in-depth understanding of the special requirements that the space environment imposes on software systems, including the impact of factors such as vacuum, radiation, and temperature on system performance. The course will explore the design and architecture of flight software, teaching students how to design flight software systems that can operate stably under extreme conditions, ensuring the smooth execution of space missions. Additionally, the course will cover software verification and validation techniques, enabling students to ensure the functionality and safety of software systems and master various testing methods and tools.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

description.zh: 本課程致力於深入研究各種低軌道衛星地面站系統的複雜結構和相關元素。課程首先介紹低軌道衛星地面站系統的基本概念，包括其在衛星通訊中的角色和功能。學生將深入了解地面站系統在支援低軌道衛星通訊方面的重要性。接著，課程將詳細介紹不同類型的地面站，如海事衛星、GEO/LEO 地面站以及固定式/移動式地面站。學生將學會分析這些地面站的特點、應用場景，以及相應的技術要求。課程的內容還包括天線次系統，涵蓋天線的種類、原理和性能特點。同時，課程將探討 LOC（地面中控系統）的功能和重要性，使學生瞭解地面站系統的集中控制和管理。接下來，學生也將深入研究資料介接網路，包括資料的傳輸方式、協定和安全性，以確保地面站系統的有效運作。最後，課程將關注其他支援系統，包括電源、控制和機構等，使學生全面理解地面站系統的整體結構和運作機制。透過實例分析，學生將獲得地面站系統架構解析的實際能力。
description.en: This course introduces the structure and key components of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite ground station systems. Students will learn the fundamental roles and functions of these systems in satellite communication, gaining insights into various types such as maritime, GEO/LEO, and fixed/mobile ground stations. The course examines their application scenarios and technical requirements, and explores antenna subsystems, including their types and performance. It also covers the Local Operations Center (LOC), highlighting centralized control and system management. Additionally, data interface networks are discussed, with emphasis on transmission methods, protocols, and security. Supporting systems like power and control mechanisms are introduced. Practical case studies help students understand and analyze ground station architectures.

The course combines lectures, discussions, and case studies to give students an in-depth understanding of AI technology and robotic applications. Students can engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and mobile robot platforms.

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

notes: 碩二生需上及下學期各有一次選課紀錄

Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

description.zh: 本課程介紹超文本標記語言 (HTML) 語法與層疊樣式表 (CSS) 之應用。課程內容包括：1. 超文本標記語言 2. 層疊樣式表 3. JavaScript 直譯式腳本語言 4. HTML5 APIs 語法 5. CSS3 特徵 6. DOM 文件物件模型 7. JQuery 函式庫 8. JSON 資訊交換語言 9. AJAX 非同步傳輸 10. SVG 可縮放向量圖形 11. HTML5 Canvas 應用程式介面 12. WebGL 三維繪圖 13. 自調式網頁設計 14. Bootstrap 15. 網頁文字編排學 16. 網頁字型。
description.en: This course introduces HyperText Markup Language (HTML) and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS). The course topics include: 1. HTML syntax, 2. CSS syntax, 3. JavaScript, 4. HTML5 APIs syntactic features, 5. CSS3 features, 6. Document Object Model (DOM), 7. jQuery library, 8. JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), 9. Asynchronous JavaScript and XML (AJAX), 10. Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG), 11. HTML5 Canvas API 12. WebGL, 13. Responsive Web Design (RWD), 14. Bootstrap, 15. Web Typography, 16 Web Fonts.

description.zh: 本課程之設計，在介紹學生資訊安全的概念，並瞭解相關的技術與應用。本課程包括下列主題：資訊安全簡介、傳統加密法、私鑰加密技術、公鑰加密技術與雜湊函數、訊息認證編碼與協定、認證系統、電子郵件安全技術、網際網路協定安全技術、全球資訊網安全技術、系統安全技術、防火牆系統等。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with the knowledge and techniques essential in information security. The topics to be covered include: introductions to information security, conventional encryption, private key technologies, public key technologies and hash functions, message authentication code and protocols, authentication systems, Kerberos, X.509 7, E-Mail security, PGP, S/MIME, IP security, Web security, SHTTP, SSL (Secure Session Layer), system security, and firewall systems.

description.zh: 本課程主要在研討傳統的結構化語言的編譯技術。課程所所涵蓋的內容包括有： - 語句上的分析、語句分析器的製作 - 由上而下的組譯器製作 - 由下而上的組譯器製作 - 語意分析 - 機器碼之產生與暫存器之配置 - 資料流分析的理論與應用 - 程式碼最佳化處理。課程的實施，將以基本編譯技術為主，作深入的介紹。學習所得的觀念與技術，將利用一個實驗性語言編譯器的實作來貫穿。因此，程式規畫實作，將在這個課程中，佔有相當大的比重。
description.en: This course discusses issues in the compilation of conventional block-structured languages, as listed below. - lexical analysis, scanner generators; - top-down parsing, LL(1) parsers; - bottom-up parsing SLR, LALR, LR(1) parsers, parser generators; - semantic analysis; - code generation and register allocation, code generator generators; - dataflow analysis: theory and practice; - code optimization. There will be a significant programming component to the course

description.zh: 本課程除了介紹物聯網技術及原理之外，更著重在檢測工具的實際操作使用，例如: packet sniffer 等，並以國網中心所建置的 CDX 雲端資安攻防平台進行實作分析與演練，讓學生能更了解技術原理的實際應用情境。課程內容包含：●物聯網技術簡介 ●物聯網安全漏洞與風險●物聯網資安檢測 ●弱點偵測 ●入侵偵測 ●異常偵測
description.en: This course aims to introduce security technologies for industrial Internet of Things and principles of industrial cyber security. The course focuses on practical exercises on using detection tools, such as packet sniffer, etc., The exercises will be performed based on the CDX cloud service environments and exercising on security attack/defense practices. Practical exercises allow students to better understand the practical applications of security technologies for industrial IoT applications. The course contents including:●Introduction to IoT technologies ●IoT vulnerabilities and risks●Security testing for IoT applications●Vulnerability detection●Intrusion detection●Anomaly detection

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊 (及訓練演算法，支援向量機，線性及邏輯回歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等．
description.en: This introductory course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of this course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, this course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optiminizations, random search, decision tree,  random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model (with its training algorithm), support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques (LDA, PCA, ICA, FA), boosting methods, decision

description.zh: 本課程介紹在數位影像處理領域中會使用到的基本觀念與技術. 數位影像處理有非常多重要的應用, 如: 影像內容改善, 工業檢測, 機器知覺等. 課程內容包括: 1. 數位影像處理的基礎 2. 影像的轉換 3. 影像的加強 4. 影像的復原 5. 彩色影像的處理 6. 影像的壓縮 7. 影像的分割與特徵抽取 8. 影像的表達及描述 9. 影像的辨認與解釋
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques used in the field of digital image processing (IP). Digital Image Processing has many important applications, for example, image contents improvement, industrial inspection, machine perception. The outline of this course is: 1.Digital image fundamentals 2.Image transforms 3.Image enhancement 4. Image restoration 5. Color image processing 6. Image compression 7. Image segmentation and feature detection 8. Representation and description 9. Recognition and interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程探討邊緣運算（Edge Computing）於現代分散式系統與智慧網路中的核心角色，強調從傳統雲端架構轉向「雲–邊–端協同（Cloud–Edge–Device Continuum）」之設計思維。課程內容涵蓋邊緣架構設計、資源配置與任務卸載（offloading）、邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）、以及與 5G/6G 通訊系統之整合。此外，課程將深入探討低延遲應用（如智慧製造、AR/VR、自駕車）、邊緣資料分析、隱私保護與安全機制，並介紹容器化（containerization）、微服務（microservices）與邊緣原生（edge-native）系統設計。透過論文文獻研讀與專題實作，使學生具備設計與實現新世代邊緣智慧系統之能力。
description.en: This course explores the principles and emerging trends of edge computing in modern distributed and intelligent network systems. It focuses on the paradigm shift from centralized cloud computing to the Cloud–Edge–Device continuum, enabling low-latency, real-time, and context-aware services. Topics include edge architecture design, resource management, task offloading, edge AI, federated learning, and integration with 5G/6G networks. The course also covers edge analytics, security and privacy, and cloud-native technologies such as containers and microservices. Students will engage in paper reading and hands-on projects to develop advanced edge-enabled intelligent systems.

name.zh: 邊緣運算與智慧網路系統
name.en: Edge Computing and Intelligent Network Systems

The goal of the course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, the course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. description.zh: 本課程介紹 X 射線特性、繞射原理及 X 射線繞射在材料科學上之應用。內容包括 X 射線之產生，X 射線之性質，X 射線之繞射理論，材料之晶體結構與繞射條件。在 X 射線繞射方法方面則介紹 Laue 照相法，粉末法，繞射儀及光譜儀等。應用方面則包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等。
description.en: Introduction to the following topics: 1. Properties of X-Ray2. Geometry of Crystals3. Principles of X-Ray Diffraction4. Experimental Methods　(Diffractometer Measurements, Powder Photographs, and Laue Photographs)5. Applications of X-ray Diffraction on Materials Science (Orientation and Quality of Single Crystal, Determine of Crystal Structure and Precise Parameter Measurements, Chemical Analysis, Phase Transformations etc.)

description.zh: 介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括 (1) 電機工程介紹，(2) 電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3) 電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4) 交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5) 暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6) 交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。
description.en: Introduce to the principles of electrical, electronic, and electromechanical engineering. The context contains: (1) Introduction to electrical engineering, (2) Fundamentals of electric circuits: electric, current, voltage, power, and Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws, (3)Resistive network analysis: node analysis, mesh analysis, the principle of superposition, Thevenie and Norton equivalent circuits, (4)AC network analysis: energy storage circuit elements and the analysis of AC circuits excited by sinusoidal voltages and currents, (5)Transient analysis: describe the behavior of a voltage or a current between two distinct steady-state conditions, (6)AC power: simple AC power calculations and the generation and distribution of electric power.

description.zh: 學習典範產業的實務經驗，帶給學生產業的思維。以真實具體的研究開發與產業經驗為教材，激發學生追求科技創新成就的渴望，強化青年學子對產業職涯的規劃。
description.en: Through the experience of industrial managers and engineers, we hope students to learn about the practical problems in the industry. By offering different topics and current trends emphasizing on the research and development of various industries, this course wishes to inspire students to pursue their careers in future time.

description.zh: 本課程從電化學概念，電極電位，及腐蝕原理中建立學生腐蝕技術，包括 DC 極化法，AC 阻抗法，諧波法，ER 測試，ERR 敏化測試高溫水溶液，應力腐蝕測試等，另外腐蝕壽命評估，材料腐蝕管理系統，核能電廠材料，地下緊密電位量測，水溶液腐蝕抑制效果，鋼筋混泥土結構防蝕效果評估均在本課程中一一介紹。
description.en: 1.Electrochemical mechanisms 2.Corrosion tendency and Electrode Potentials 3.Polarization and Corrosion Rates 4.Theories of Passivity 5.Corrosion Prevention 6.Eight forms of Corrosion 7.High Temprature Corrosion

description.zh: 一、簡介 (Outline) 二、導電材料 (Conductors) 三、電阻材料 (Resistors) 四、絕緣材料 (Insulators) 五、半導體材料 (Semiconductors) 六、介電材料 (Dielectrics) 七、磁性材料 (Magnetics) 八、壓電材料 (Piezoelectrics) 九、超導材料 (Superconductors) 十、感測材料 (Sensors)
description.en: This course is a special topics of Electronic Materials.

description.zh: 主要介紹陶瓷之製程及所應用的範圍.
description.en: Introduction to The processes of ceramics materials and their application

description.zh: 課程綱要：1. 半導體元件簡介 2. 物理氣相沉積 3. 化學氣相沉積 4. 微影─光阻覆蓋，曝光，顯影 5. 蝕刻─濕式蝕刻，乾式蝕刻 6. 攙雜─擴散法，離子植入法 7. 氧化和熱處理製程
description.en: Course Outline：1.Introduction to Semiconductor Device2.Physical Vapor Deposition3.Chemical Vapor Deposition4.Photolithography─photoresist coating, exposure, development5.Etching─wet etching, dry etching6.Doping─diffusion, ion implantation7.Oxidation and Thermal Treatment Process

description.zh: 講述鑄造學之基本原理，概念，以及實際應用技巧，基本原理上，以材料的凝固解析學為主。包括：熱傳導及流動性等基本原理。應用上包含金屬、非金屬、高分子等其他原材料之鑄造方法、技巧之介紹。
description.en: It lectures the fundamental principles, concept and practical applied technique,basically speaking, it is mainly based on solidification and analytic process, which includes the fundamental principles of heat transfer and flowability. In practice, it covers the introduction of casting method of metal, non-metal, polymer and othermaterials.

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 限碩二, 修課人數為 35 名 材資館 5 樓演講廳

description.zh: 對無機化合物之結構，化學性質等，利用量子化學，群論及結晶化學等加以探討。以配合天然礦物之形成，產狀，地球化學及環境化學等學科之授課內容。
description.en: The chemical structure and properties of inorganic compounds, which are useful for the following courses: the forming and occurrence of minerals, earth and environmental chemistry, will be discussed by using quantum chemistry, group theory and crystallography.

description.zh: 電化學工程特論的領域眾多，舉凡腐蝕現象與電泳作用的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了介紹基本的電化學原理外，另將著重於電化學分析方法在能源與生醫系統研究上的應用。
description.en: Special topics in the field of electrochemistry include many different phenomena (e.g., corrosion and electrophoresis, electro analytical sensors and batteries devices, and the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine technologies……). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electro-analytical methods to the study of energy and biomedical systems.

description.zh: 本課程著重於中英文口頭報告能力之培養，在模擬發表過程中，培養學生使用正確的表達用法，並建立適當之應對方式。
description.en: This course offers opportunities for students to develop their oral presentation skills in both Chinese and English languages via simulated presentations in class. Students will learn how to present their papers precisely and how to engage a conversation properly.

description.zh: 本課程教授系統分析之模擬方法應用於能源動力系統之穩態與動態分析 (malab)。內容包括能源系統個元件之特性分析與數學模型介紹，系統元件包括；壓縮機、渦輪機、熱交換器、與質子交換膜燃料電池系統。授課單元如下；1. 數值方法介紹 2. 能源系統元件數學模型與程式撰寫壓縮機   渦輪機   熱交換器 3. 能源系統分析範例；燃料電池系統分析流道 model、氣體擴散層 model、燃料電池質傳與電化學傳輸與程式範例
description.en: The course is a system analysis method for performing steady-state and dynamic system simulations of lumped component system (matlab). These methods are essentially a numerical analysis; the course teach student to set up various system composed of; compressor, turbine, heat exchanger, reformer and fuel cell system. Course lectures are listed as:1.Numerical method 2.System components modeling Compressor   Turbine   Heat exchanger3.Case study of energy system; fuel cell system analysisFlow modeling, GDL model, mass & charge transport and programing

description.zh: 本課程是大學部程度的巨量資料分析導論課程，主要介紹資料前處理、資料探勘概念、關聯分析、分類、分群、平行化程式設計、分散式計算、以及實際平台工具如: MapReduce, Spark 等。除了基本概念的介紹外，透過程式練習以及期末專題，能讓學生深入理解巨量資料分析的基本原理以及實際工具的應用。
description.en: This undergraduate-level course offers an introduction to the concepts in big data analytics. Topics include data preprocessing, data mining, association rule, classification, clustering, parallel programming, distributed computing, MapReduce, and Spark. Programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the basic ideas and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

description.zh: 全球遊戲產業包含電腦、遊戲主機、手機遊戲等，市場產值高達上百億美元。虛擬實境和擴增實境的應用更從遊戲、影音娛樂及廣告行銷多元發展與推廣。Unity 是一套支援多平台的遊戲開發工具，其強大的功能與豐富的資源，使得任何人都可以快速的進入遊戲開發的世界，更為目前各大遊戲公司所採用之遊戲開發工具。比起早期的開發方式，Unity 之強大功能與易上手特性更能節省開發時間與成本。學生想要創業製作遊戲也不再是夢想。 此課程內容會教授同學如何使用 Unity 遊戲引擎來開發實作遊戲。從最基礎的認識介面編輯器，到如何套用物理模擬效果，以及創建場景及調配燈光皆會依不同單元慢慢教授。課程將以每周一個 Unity 開發單元搭配一個小作業的方式進行。課程並包含目前最熱門的虛擬實境和擴增實境的應用程式之製作，讓同學可以在一學期內開發出完整的遊戲。(修課須具備基礎：物件導向程式設計能力）
description.en: This course teaches the core skills for Game Development in Unity 3D. This game development course from Infinite Skills introduces you to the fundamentals of 3D game design with the Unity engine. This tutorial is designed with the absolute beginner in mind; no prior experience with Unity is required.You will start by exploring the Unity interface, and learning how to manipulate objects in the editor. Throughout this course, you will learn how to develop 2D/3D games, augmented reality and virtual reality applications.You will learn how to import assets for the game, apply physics to objects in the game, and how to combine assets to create complex objects. You will add animation and manage lighting for the game. Finally you will render and build the game for distribution.Once you have completed this course, you will have a strong grasp of the fundamentals needed to build a functional game using the Unity 3D engine.

description.zh: IMBA 學生必須寫一篇論文來滿足碩士學位的要求。
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助高階管理階層作決策。一般而言，這門課為商學課程中的課程主要協助學員們具有整合能力。學員不只是在策略管理中應活學活用，也融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課將幫助您學習、研讀個案和討論，這是此門課的目標。 1. 瞭解組織所處環境 2. 分析外部環境之時機和危機 3. 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 4. 探討企業不同層次之應對策略。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making at the top management level. Traditionally, this course has been the capstone course in the business program and is taught at the last year of study so that students can integrate functional area knowledge into a coherent one. Students are expected not only to learn a body of knowledge on strategic management, but also to synthesize economics, accounting, and marketing as an aid top management level decisions. We will use a combination of readings, case studies, and lectures to achieve the goals of the course.

notes: 經管所、資財所、IMBA 和管理博合開

description.zh: 本課程探討資訊系統在現代組織中所扮演的角色，課程重點將放在企業電子化和電子商務，同學在修課過後將具備相關知識。課堂中的資訊實務技術演練，將有助於同學有效率地解決相關問題。
description.en: This course provides the knowledge you need to understand the role of information systems in modern organizations, with particular focus on E-commerce and E-business. Along with skills learned in your functional area, knowledge from this course will help you effectively use information technology for solving business problems.

description.zh: 介紹 VBA 語言基本資料處理的概念，包含基本輸入與輸出、程式的流程控制、函數的應用等指令之撰寫、程式之編輯、編譯、聯絡與程式之執行，並發展一套應用程式。
description.en: This course introduces the basic data processes of EXCEL VBA language. They include input/output, program process control, application of functions, program editing and execution, and so on.

description.zh: 「企業領導力」是企業經營管理中非常重要元素和指標。我們將由學術理論和商業實務案例中，共同分析和探討企業領導力的管理策略; 並著重於企業價值創新，以培育高教學生具有全球商業開發和經營管理的領導技能。
description.en: The course, Corporate leadership, is offered from a practitioner’s viewpoints on how to deploy the concepts, knowledge, theories and experiences for the development of business leadership practice and to achieve the corporate value creation. In the current market-lead and ubiquitous technology driven world, the Corporate Leadership role is not just the corporate internal management concerning but also needs a broad range of issues, such as cross-cultural knowledge and strategic thinking on business development, communication skills with innovative ideas, and management techniques for the long-term business goals. We will expand the scope and scale of the research related, review articles, complete class projects, and discuss real business cases.

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究 ，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 專題演講或書報討論
description.en: In this course, we will invite speakers from the academia, industry and government to lectures on topics in computer science and information engineering.

description.zh: 本課程分為兩部分：（1）英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可加強基本句型練習、句子改正及句型修正。相關討論包括直述句、引述句、句型變化與修飾;（2）英語修辭法：聽講溝通的有效原理原則。課堂討論主題包括：指稱、一致、倒裝等修辭觀念。修習本課後，學生對出現在相同邏輯意義語境中， 利用不同表達方式以凸顯各種語意的方式與內涵，當有更進一步的體認。
description.en: This course is divided into two parts: (a) The first part is designed for the students to  familiarize themselves with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing. A review of grammatical ideas at high level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include English sentence structures, verbal usages, conjunctions, and sequences. Related topics for class discussion cover direct and indirect speech, sentence transformation and modification of sentences; (b) The second half of the course focuses on English rhetoric--principles of effective written and spoken communication. Topics for class discussion include reference, coherence, reverse structures and some related rhetorical concepts. It is hoped that the students will know better the significance brought about by the variations of different expressions that occur in the similar linguistic contexts.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號除 3 餘 2，02/05/08 等，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程旨在進一步加強學生的口語表達溝通之能力。經由合宜的活動設計，如小組討論，與英語談話情境的塑造，如面談，學生將獲得充分機會以演練聽講的技巧。
description.en: This course is designed to develop oral communication skills at a higher level. Stimulated theme-based scenarios and authentic content will be used to engage students with the purpose of generating lively conversation, and video films. Activities include task-based pair and small-group discussion for maximum practice and personalization.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號除 3 餘 2，02/05/08 等，僅限英文系學生修讀
