Stimulated theme-based scenarios and authentic content will be used to engage students with the purpose of generating lively conversation, and video films. Activities include task-based pair and small-group discussion for maximum practice and personalization.

notes: C 組 - 學號尾號 3 的倍數，03/06/09 等，僅限英文系學生修

description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生撰寫結構完整段落和短文之能力, 並著重如何重寫、摘要、 轉述、 陳述、筆記、編排、起草、修改等相關技巧。
description.en: This course is expected to expand students’ writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號除 3 餘 2，02/05/08 等，僅限英文系學生修讀【停開】

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

description.zh: 本課程旨在訓練學生公開表達之能力，內容包括語言表達基本原則與技巧、肢體語言與演講要領，備題演講及即席演講演練。
description.en: This course is designed to enable students to develop the principles and skills necessary for public speaking. Included will be guidelines for giving a speech and displaying body language, and practices for prepared speech and impromptu speech.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號數偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程主要敘述數位語音訊號的處理技術及語音相關應用。討論的課題主要包括語音分析的基本聲學原理如發音模型與語音特徵分析，以及語音編碼、語音合成、語音辨認等重要應用。
description.en: This course is intended to introduce the fundamentals of speech signal processing and related applications. The topics it will address include speech production model, extraction and evaluation of speech features, basic principles of speech analysis and synthesis, speech coding, and speech recognition, etc.

description.zh: 電容切換式電路、振盪器、濾波器、鎖相迴路、非線性與匹配效應、短通道效應與元件模型、類比電路佈局與包裝
description.en: Switched-capacitor circuits, Oscillators, Continuous-time filters, Phase-locked loop, Nonlinearity and mismatch, Short-channel effects and device models, Layout and packaging for analog IC.

name.zh: 高等類比積體電路設計

notes: 電機所和創新半導體合開

description.zh: 1. 永磁電機理論 2. 控制法則分析與模擬 3. 動態特性分析 4. 近代應用介紹
description.en: 1.Basic theory of operation 2. Control strategies analysis and simulation 3. Dynamic performance analysis 4. Introduction to recent applications of the PMSM.

name.zh: 永磁同步電動機之理論與控制
name.en: Theory and Control of Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motor

description.zh: 1. 簡介 2. 線性區段碼 3. 循環碼 4. 迴旋碼 5. 編碼調變
description.en: 1.Introduction2.Linear Block Codes3.Cyclic Codes4.Convolutional Codes5.Coded Modulation

description.zh: 此課程主要是含蓋無線通訊基頻訊號處理的理論基礎與系統架構，探討無線通道所能提供的通道容量以及可靠通訊。而大部分的課程內容會以目前熱門的多輸入多輸出 (MIMO) 傳輸為背景而進行探討。課程綱要如下: 1. 無線通道模型 2. 多樣性 3. 通道容量 4.MIMO I: 空間多工 5.MIMO II: 通道容量與多工架構 6.MIMO III: 多樣性與多工間取捨 7.MIMO IV: 多使用者通訊
description.en: This course provides thefundamental theories and architectures for baseband wireless communications. It is concerned that how reliable communication can be achieved and what is the capacity a channel can provide. Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-inputmultiple-output (MIMO) transmission.Course outline:1.The Wireless Channel 2.Diversity3.Capacity of Wireless Channels4.MIMO I: Spatial Multiplexing 5.MIMO II: Capacity and Multiplexing Architectures6.MIMO III: Diversity-Multiplexing Tradeoff7.MIMO IV: Multiuser Communication

description.zh: 本課程目標能培育具備跨域能力的智慧醫療人才，課程採理論與實作並重的教學模式，從醫學資料處理基礎出發，循序漸進引導學生掌握機器學習核心技術與深度學習方法。課程內容涵蓋醫學影像處理、傳統機器學習、深度學習架構及相關進階主題，使學生建立完整的智慧醫療技術基礎。培養目標包含掌握醫學資料處理與分析技術、具備機器學習與深度學習基礎能力、能夠完成智慧醫療相關專題研究、建立跨域合作與問題解決能力。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate interdisciplinary talent in smart healthcare. The curriculum adopts a balanced approach between theory and practice, progressively guiding students from fundamental medical data processing to mastering core machine learning techniques and deep learning methods. Course content covers medical image processing, traditional machine learning, deep learning architectures, and related advanced topics, establishing a comprehensive foundation in smart healthcare technologies. Through multiple practical units and a capstone project, the course develops students' technical expertise, independent research capabilities, and cross-disciplinary communication skills in the smart healthcare domain.Learning objectives include mastering medical data processing and analysis techniques, developing foundational proficiency in machine learning and deep learning, completing practical projects in smart healthcare applications, and building cross-disciplinary collaboration and pr

name.zh: 智慧醫療與機器學習基礎
name.en: AI and Machine Learning in Healthcare

description.zh: 本研究所課程從認知語用學視角，探知語言如何造成框架效應 (framing effects) 影響人們對事件的感知、詮釋與決策。課程內容含括概念隱喻	(conceptual metaphor)、詞彙選擇 (lexical selection)、文體結構 (discourse structure) 等核心語言學議題，並檢視這些語言要素如何影響個人與社會對概念的建構。語料分析涉及廣告、政治語言及日常溝通中的框架現象，探討語言如何被用來說服受眾、強化意識形態、塑造公眾輿論。課程關注框架背後的基本認知機制, 包括心理模型 (mental	models) 與語言理解偏誤	(biases)。透過開放式討論、實證案例研究與話語分析實作，本課程將幫助學生深入理解語言與認知如何交互作用，進而影響人們對現實的建構與詮釋。本課程適合對語言學、認知科學、傳播學及媒體 (廣告) 語言分析感興趣的同學。
description.en: Cognitive Pragmatics in Media Communication is a graduate course that examines how language shapes perception, interpretation, and decision-making through framing effects, drawing insights from cognitive pragmatics. It explores how linguistic choices—such as conceptual metaphor, lexical selection, and discourse structure—influence how individuals and societies construct meaning. Students will analyze framing effects in advertising, political discourse, media narratives, and everyday communication, investigating how language is used to persuade, reinforce ideologies, and shape public opinion. The course also considers the cognitive mechanisms behind framing, including mental models and biases in language comprehension. Through open discussions, empirical case studies, and hands-on discourse analysis, students will develop a deeper understanding of how language interacts with cognition to frame reality. This course is ideal for students in linguistics, cognitive science, communicatio

description.zh: 本課程介紹工程相關之主要數值分析方法及其於大地工程之應用，如有限差分法及有限元素法。透過實例問題之解析，使學生除了具有理論的基礎外，同時有能力藉著數值分析方法來分析大地工程問題。
description.en: This course introduces two representative numerical methods, i.e.  finite difference method and finite element method, and their application to geotechnical engineering.  Practical engineering problem are illustrated and simulated by numerical methods in the courses.  It aims to train the students to be familiar with either the theorem of numerical analysis or the application to engineering practices.

description.zh: 本課程著重在奈米材料的合成以及鑑定，包含氣相反應以及溶液相反應。課程核心內容為：(1) 各式溶液相合成奈米粉末、中空奈米球以及奈米線 (2) 氣相反應合成奈米管、奈米線 (3) 分子轉印技術 (4) 奈米材料檢測技術
description.en: This course will cover the syntheses and characterization of various nanomaterials. The core lectures include:1. syntheses of nanoparticles, hollow nanospheres and nanowires from solutions2. syntheses of nanowires and nanotubes from the gas phase3. molecular imprinting4. characterization and properties of nanomaterials

description.zh: 本課程聚焦文化轉譯在當代文化事業中的策略應用，探討如何將文化內容轉化為可被理解、感知，並具再創造潛力的創意資源，透過將文化、知識、符號轉化為新載體，作為推動跨域創新的基礎。課程強調文化轉譯作為連結文化價值與創意應用的重要機制，並引導學生理解其在不同產業語境中的實作可能。本課程同時關注跨域創新的行動實踐，透過多元個案的探討，讓學生學習如何在文化內容、產業需求與社會語境之間展開對話，設計具策略性與文化敏感度的創新提案。學生將從實務導向的練習中，發展將文化內容轉譯為創意與應用性高的專案能力。課程內容涵蓋文化轉譯的理論基礎、語境共融策略、跨文化再現倫理，並延伸至創意商品開發、展覽設計、跨界合作模式與公共參與實踐等領域。
description.en: This course focuses on the strategic application of cultural transcreation within the contemporary creative industries. It explores how cultural content can be transformed into creative resources that are understandable, perceptible, and capable of inspiring new forms of creation. Through the transformation of culture, knowledge, and symbols into new carriers, cultural transcreation is positioned as a foundational mechanism for driving cross-disciplinary innovation.Emphasizing the role of cultural translation as a bridge between cultural values and creative applications, the course guides students to understand how such processes can be practiced across diverse industry contexts. In addition to theoretical exploration, the course highlights the practical dimension of cross-disciplinary innovation. Through a range of case studies, students will examine how to navigate between cultural content, industry demands, and social contexts to develop culturally sensitive and strategically soun

name.zh: 文化轉譯策略與跨域創新
name.en: Strategic Cultural Transcreation and cross-disciplinary Innovation

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

notes: 排一般教室, 互動二與外生二合開, 限本系 30 人

description.zh: 隨著生成式 AI 與大型語言模型迅速融入設計流程與數位產品開發，互動設計者需具備整合 AI 技術與人機介面設計的跨域素養。本課程旨在探討人工智慧技術於人機互動設計中的應用，培養學生設計與開發智慧互動系統的核心能力。課程內容涵蓋人機互動及互動設計之基本概念、語意理解與回應機制、以及 AI 驅動之使用者體驗創新。教學上將透過講述法和工作坊建立基礎觀念，搭配上機實作強化技術操作能力，並以專題導向學習形式，引導學生完成從構思到原型開發之完整設計流程。
description.en: As generative AI and large language models (LLMs) reshape design processes, interaction designers must integrate AI technologies with human-computer interface design to enhance the user experience. This course explores the application of AI in human-computer interaction (HCI), focusing on essential skills for developing intelligent interactive systems. Topics include HCI fundamentals, semantic understanding and response mechanisms, and AI-driven innovations in user experience. Lectures build theoretical foundations, hands-on practice strengthens technical skills, and project-based learning guides students from ideation to prototyping.

notes: 互動三和互動所合開, 排先鋒 PBL 教室, 限 25 人修, 自備筆電

description.zh: 以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。教學目標為：1. 介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。2. 訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。3. 熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en: This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.The objectives are:1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

notes: 互動日碩和外生四合開, 光華 409, 限合開班級修, 預選 13 人

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

description.zh: 校務研究（Institutional Research，以下簡稱 IR）可說是針對校務所進行的各項研究，透過資料蒐集、分析、報告，以及教職員行動，以促進高等教育機構的運作與決定。同時 IR 的發展和大學評鑑的發展脈絡息息相關，最終的目的就是要提升學校辦學品質，促進學校良善發展。本課程主要希望加強同學對 IR 的了解及發展實作能力。
description.en: Institutional research is a broad category of work done at schools, colleges and universities to inform campus decision-making and planning in areas such as admissions, financial aid, curriculum, enrollment management, staffing, student life, finance, facilities, athletics, and alumni relations. Its mission is to foster a culture of evidence by facilitating the management, analysis, and reporting of institutional data and information in support of planning and decision-making. This curriculum is expected to provide all students understand the theory and practice of IR.

description.zh: 針對職業內容、從業人員條件、職業相關資料，與職業手冊編製與運用進行主題探討，同時，就技職教育與訓練或人力資源等領域的相關從業人員進行能力分析，挑選有興趣之子題研擬，心得報告於課堂中研討。
description.en: The course aims to (1) exploration of the main research in occupation analysis, (2) exploration of competency analysis in technical-vocational education and training program or in the field of human resource. Topics include occupation contents, the requirement of enterprise worker, occupation relation occupation, and the application & compilation of occupational manual. Discussion, selected topics research, and reporting in class are required.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛設計分析」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計能力之人員，本課程初期將從規範面瞭解車輛設計要求，進而從結構面進行車輛設計與分析，過程中將引導學生採用主流分析軟體進行車輛穩定性與行車舒適度探討。最後將探討與台灣既有鐵道系統的相容性，進行駕駛室與機電設備配置等設計。期望透過本課程，能培植鐵道車輛設計分析人才，厚植本土鐵道車輛設計能力。
description.en: This aim of the course of "Railway Vehicle Design and Analysis" is to cultivate personnel on railway vehicle field. At the beginning of this course, the design requirement and criteria will be given as basic knowledge. Then students will be ask to perform structural design and analysis for railway vehicles. Passenger comfortable index and vehicle dynamic response will be taken into consideration during the process of design and analysis. Finally, the compatibility of the new design with the existing railway system will be discussed.

description.zh: 以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。 教學目標為： 1. 介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。 2. 訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。 3. 熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en: This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching. The objectives are: 1) Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 2) Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 3) Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

notes: 互動日碩和外生四合開, 光華 409, 限合開班級修, 預選 13 人

description.zh: 以科學方法探討聚合物特性，使學生了解分子結構與物性的關係、物性之測定方法及物性與加工應用上之關係。
description.en: The unique features of polymers are introduced.  Specialemphasis is given to the structuring effects of processingon polymer morphology and properties.

notes: 網路預選限 40 人; 大三合開; 核心 4 選 1

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材 (富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料 (二硫化鉬與金屬化) 等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

notes: 先鋒教室; 網路預選限 25 人 (大學部);化工四、所合開

description.zh: 本課程著重在材料製程中所發生的輸送現象為探討目標, 並使用《Transport Phenomena in Materials Processing》做為教材，旨在建立研究生對動量、能量與質量傳輸之系統性理解。課程將從基本守恆原理出發，理解並掌握流體動力學方程式、熱傳方程與擴散模型，並深入探討其在金屬凝固、熱處理、半導體擴散及材料加工製程中的工程應用。課程特別強調問題定義、尺度分析與物理意義詮釋，培養學生由理論模型連結至實際製程現象之能力，為後續高階製程模擬、數值分析與研究論文撰寫奠定紮實基礎。
description.en: This course studies transport phenomena in materials processing, and the primary textbook for this graduate-level course was selected as “Transport Phenomena in Materials Processing”. The lecture content integrates fluid dynamics, energy transport, and mass transport in materials processing and engineering applications. Rather than treating transport phenomena as abstract mathematical formulations, the lecturer aims to emphasize the derivation of governing equations from fundamental conservation laws and highlight their physical meaning in real processing systems.Topics include laminar and turbulent flow, heat conduction and convection, radiation, diffusion in solids, solidification, and interphase mass transfer, all with strong engineering relevance. The structured development of the Navier–Stokes equations, energy equation, and diffusion models equips students with the analytical tools necessary to interpret and model coupled transport phenomena encountered in casting, heat trea

description.zh: 本課程著重於教授現代有機合成方法、反應機構、及其應用等知識，並幫助學生了解有機化學與生物化學、藥學等領域之相關性，進而拓展到將來學術及工業上的研究與應用。
description.en: This course focuses the contemporary developments in the study of the structure of carbon compounds and the mechanism of their reactions. Selected topics such as natural product, heterocyclic compound, stereochemistry, aromaticity, reaction intermediates, peptides synthesis and photochemistry will be included.

description.zh: 無塵室之構成、恆溫恆溼控制、粉塵控制、過濾系統、環境測定、操作管理、針對電子工業之應用。
description.en: Clean room system, temperature and humidity control, particle control, filtering system, testing and measurement, operation and maintenance. This course focuses on the application in the electronic industry.

description.zh: 系統功能分析，空調系統設計概要，負荷計算理論，送風與風管系統分析，送水系統分析，冷卻水塔熱質傳分析，主機系統性能分析
description.en: System function analysis, introduction to system designs of air-conditioning, theories on cooling load calculation, air moving and duct system analysis, water system analysis, heat and mass transfer in cooling towers, performance analysis of chillers

description.zh: 熱交換器設計方法、單向對流熱傳計算、壓差計算、冷凝器與蒸發器分析、殼管式熱交換器分析、密集式熱交換器分析、濕盤管理論分析
description.en: Design methods, forced convection correlations for single phase heat exchange, pressure calculation, condensers and evaporators analysis, shell and tube heat exchanger analysis, compact heat exchanger analysis, wet coil analysis.

notes: EMI, 能源所和機電博 (外生) 班合開

description.zh: 機械振動、非線性振動、振動量測、振動抑制及隔離技術、振動與波之傳播、聲音之反射及折射、噪音之降低及吸音材料、消音器與噪音控制、法規及環境等。
description.en: Topics include: Mechanical vibration, Vibration  transmission, Vibration measurement, The use of vibration isolators and absorbers, Fundamentals of acoustics, Noise control engineering, Instrumentation and Law.

notes: 機電、外生專班合開，限 20 人，英文授課

description.zh: 現代控制理論簡介、線性空間分析、狀態方程式及響應、可控制性及可觀測性、穩定性分析、狀態回授及估測、控制器設計及應用、觀測。
description.en: Introduction of Modern Control Theory﹒Linear space Analysis, State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability, Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Modern Control theory.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en: This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement.The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。

description.zh: 課程主要為介紹學術界最新的深度學習研究成果，教導學員使用 Python 深度學習套件，讓學員能將深度學習技術應用於各個不同的領域。課程內容包括：?車牌與門牌數字辨識? 人臉辨識? 1000 種影像分類? 辨識 9000 種物件  ?自動駕駛模擬? 嵌入式深度學習演算法? 空虛, 寂寞, 覺得冷? 讓深度學習來幫助你:? 遞迴式神經網路 (RNN)：找不到人聊天？訓練自己的聊天機器人? 對抗生成網路 (GAN)：用 GAN 產生自己的夢中情人? 深度強化學習 (DRL)：訓練 AI 跟你一起玩遊戲
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce latest deep learning researches and allow students to develop deep learning applications using Python library (TensorFlow & Keras). The content includes:?Number recognition of License plate and Doorplate?Face Recognition?1000 Image Classification?9000 Object Detection?Autopilot simulation?Embedded Deep Learning Algorithms?Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)?Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN)?Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM)?Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)?Deep Reinforcement Learning

name.zh: 深度學習應用開發實務

notes: 電子所、電資外生所和創新 AI 合開

description.zh: 1. 人工智慧簡介 2. 陳述式邏輯 3. 確定模型之學習 4. 非確定型知識之表示 5. 貝式網路 6. 機率式模型之參數學習 7. 機率式模型之結構學習 8. 非監督式學習 9. 基因法則 10. 基因規劃法 11. 粒子群最佳化演算法
description.en: 1. Introduction to Artificial Intelligence2. Propositional Logic3. Learning of Deterministic Models4. Representation of Uncertain Knowledge5. Bayesian Networks6. Parameter Learning of Probabilistic Models7. Structure Learning of Probabilistic Models8. Unsupervised Learning 9. Genetic Algorithm10. Genetic Programming11. Particle Swarm Optimization

notes: 電機所、電資外生所和創新 AI 合開

description.zh: 這門課程主要是介紹資料庫系統的理論與應用，內容包含有： 1. 資料庫系統的介紹與架構 2. ER 資料模式 3. 檔案儲存結構 4. 關連式資料模式 5. SQL 查詢語言 6. ER 資料模式與關連式資料模式之間的轉換 7. 資料庫正規化 8. 最佳化查詢 9. 交易處理
description.en: This course provides introduction to both database system theory and application. These are the following : o 1. Database System Concepts and Architecture -2. Data Modeling Using the Entity-Relationship Model --3. Record Storage and Primary File Organizations -4. -The Relational Data Model -5. SQL -6. ER- and ERR-to Relational Mapping -7. Functional Dependencies and Normalization for Relational Databases -8. Query Processing and Optimization -9. Transaction Processing Concepts

notes: 電機所、創新 AI 和創新資安合開, 預選 40 人

description.zh: 將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。
description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy andits equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solutionthermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change,computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning amathmatics model of metallurgy.

description.zh: 寶石業為台灣新興的工業之一，集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於此門學問，寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。人造寶石之製造與辨認，均讓學習者有能力鑑定其真偽，價值與市場行為。
description.en: Introduction the physics and chemistry properties of gemstones.

description.zh: 訓練學生獨立思考，培養學生對礦物資源之認識及應用能力，專題內容包括資源開發及地質工程、資源應用及材料合成、以及資源處理及材料製程等三大專長領域。學生必須研讀相關文獻後再研討專題實驗內容，並對實驗及結果加以詳述，而完成學士論文報告。
description.en: This course is trying to train independent thinking, to cultivate understanding and apply ability of mineral resources, the content of this subject includes the mining and geology engineering, the use of resources and materials synthesis, the resources and materials handling process, etc.. All the students must study related documents before they research the subject-matter content, they have to make a detailed report to the experiment and result at the final report.

name.en: Special Topics on Mineral Resources Engineering (II)

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意本課程將深入的討論製程中材料之性質。尤其是在材料行為的理論推導方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：塑性加工、顯微結構、強化機構、破壞力學、潛變與疲勞、材料之熱膨脹、熱傳導、電化學性質、擴散理論、相變化動力學、化學性質、以及材料之熱力學性質。
description.en: The properties of materials in service will be discussed in detail.  Special focus will be on the theoretically discussion of the behavior of materials.  Topics covered include plastic deformation、strengthening mechanisms、fracture、creep and fatigue、heat capacity、thermal expansion、thermal conductivity、the law of electrolysis、electrolytic conductance and transport, and ionic activity、reversible electrode potentials、Irreversible electrode processes、electrochemical measurements、kinetics of phase transformation、diffusion、kirkendall effect、thermodynamic properties of alloy systems、thermodynamics of surfaces and interfaces

notes: 製科 / 機械外生和機電博 (外生) 班合開, 20 人, EMI

description.zh: 1. 簡介 2. 網路定律及元件 3. 電路分析簡介 4. 節點電壓及迴路電流 5. 網路特性 6. 一階電路 7. 二階電路 8. 線性非時變電路 9. 電力網路與穩定度分析 10. 電路幾何學
description.en: This course is designed for students who have taken the course in introductory electrical engineering.1. Basic Concepts  2.Kirchhoff's Laws and Elements.  3.Circuit Analysis.  4.Node Voltages and Loop Currents. 5.Characteristics of Circuits.  6.First-Order Circuits  7.Second-Order Circuits   8.Linear Time-Invariant Circuits  9.Network Functions and Stability  10.Circuit Topology and General Circuit Analysis

description.zh: 「數據啟發設計思考（Data-informed Design Thinking）」課程旨在結合數據分析與設計思考，通過實踐項目提升學生在現代設計環境中的問題解決能力。本課程將引導學生掌握如何從數據中提取關鍵洞察，並結合設計思考中的使用者需求、創意思考與解決方案原型的開發。學生將學習如何有效地應用數據，來支持設計決策與創新。課程以 Project-Based Learning 為教學模式，學生將在實際設計項目中探索如何將數據與設計思考相結合，最終交付一個完整的數據驅動設計解決方案與數據視覺化。這門課不僅培養學生的技術技能，還強調協作、反思與迭代改進的設計思考過程，幫助學生為未來數據密集型的設計環境做好準備。
description.en: The "Data-informed Design Thinking" course aims to combine data analysis and design thinking to improve students' problem-solving abilities in modern design environments through practical projects. This course will guide students in how to extract key insights from data, combining user needs, creative thinking and solution prototype development in design thinking. Students will learn how to effectively apply data to support design decisions and innovation. The course uses Project-Based Learning as the teaching model. Students will explore how to combine data with design thinking in actual design projects, and ultimately deliver a complete data-driven design solution and data visualization. This course not only cultivates students' technical skills, but also emphasizes the design thinking process of collaboration, reflection and iterative improvement, helping students prepare for the data-intensive design environment of the future.

description.zh: 本課程探討服務與情境中的體驗設計，研究如何透過行為模式、情境塑造與敘事策略，提升人們在服務系統中的體驗感受。內容涵蓋儀式與行為設計 (Ritual & Behavior Design)、敘事體驗 (Narrative Experience)、顧客旅程 (Customer Journey) 與體驗價值創造 (Experience Value Creation) 等主題。學生將透過觀察研究、服務體驗分析與角色扮演等方法，學習如何設計具有情感共鳴與文化意義的服務與情境，並透過設計提升人們的日常體驗品質。
description.en: This course examines the design of experiences within services and specific contexts, focusing on behavioral patterns, storytelling strategies, and situational design to enhance user experience. Topics include ritual and behavior design, narrative experience, customer journey mapping, and experience value creation. Students will employ research methods such as observational studies, service experience analysis, and roleplaying to explore how to design emotionally resonant and culturally significant service experiences, ultimately improving the quality of everyday interactions.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在提供有志從事教育工作的學生有關教育心理學的系統知識使其在未來從事教職時，具最有效的方法瞭解，敘述，預測及其學生的行為並從而採用最佳的教學方式，以達成教育目標。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: The object of this course is to introduce the educational psychology to the students who are receiving teacher education. It presents the students with the basic psychology theories of instructional process; mental-physical development; the principles of learning and instruction; cultivating of thinking and creative; motivation and interest in instructing process; the measurement of individual difference; proper instructions against differently mental students; teacher-student relationship and students behaviors; instruction evaluation. After finishing this course, students will have better understanding regarding the factors shaping the students’ behaviors, as well as can choose the best instructional ways for the teaching.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

notes: 第一階段，可預修 (需額外繳交學分費)

description.zh: 本課程包含「職業教育與訓練」及「生涯規劃」兩大主題。在「職業教育與訓練」部份，針對職業教育與訓練做整體性介紹，促使學生瞭解我國技職教育重要政策與特色、認識我國技職教育之設置群科、建立學生從事技職教育教學之基礎。在「生涯規劃」部份，針對除了加強學生自我覺察與職涯規劃，也增進學生未來任教時，協助自己的學生進行職涯探索與規劃的能力。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: This course involves "Vocational Education and Training" and "Career Planning" two main topics. The "Vocational Education and Training" topic offers an introduction about vocational education and training, such as (a) flexible adjustment the system of vocational education and training in Taiwan; (b) emphasizing vocation education and training system; (c) establish solid theoretical foundation of the vocational education and training. The "Career Planning" topic offers an introduction to the concept of career to not only enhance students' self-awareness and the skills of career planning, but also use those skills to assist their future students to prepare their career planning.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

name.zh: 職業教育與訓練暨生涯規劃
name.en: Vocational Education and Training and Career Planning

notes: 限 [113 年教育專業課程版本] 師資生修 (需額外繳交學分費

description.zh: 「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。 教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: The teachers should keep in mind the duty to guide students to overcome the frustration or to solve difficult problems as to nurture students to be healthy, positive, with their own abilities to overcome difficulties and to be apt to the environment. The object of this subject is to help students with the willingness to be teachers get the knowledge and abilities of guidance on their teaching in the future, and develop willingness and interests of guidance. This course presents students with the units including  understanding the symptom of adolescent frustration, the method of person-center approach, the method of rational-emotive therapy, the method of cognitive therapy, the method of behavior therapy. In addition, this course also introduces many practical cases so that students can  effectively study the relevant theories. Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

notes: 第一階段，可預修 (需額外繳交學分費)

description.zh: 本課程在培養師培生之課程與教學設計相關知能，具體目標：(一) 瞭解課程相關學理概念，具備課程設計之思辨力；(二) 善用課程設計原理，設計符合課綱、學生需求之課程教材；(三) 瞭解並善用教學原理，進行有效的教學設計。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: The purpose of this course is to make students understand how to design different curriculum for every different course. The designer have to totally understand the needs of this course and know the detail of every technique. description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧（AI）如何整合並提升語言學習與教學。學生將學習第二語言習得理論，如互動理論與社會文化理論，並連結這些理論與 AI 輔助語言學習工具。透過實作與專題討論，學生將實際操作 AI 工具，並從學習者與教師的角度設計有效且具倫理意識的 AI 語言學習任務。課程旨在培養學生的 AI 素養，使其能夠批判性地評估與應用 AI 技術，以因應課堂內外多元的語言學習與教學需求。
description.en: This course explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated and enhance language learning and teaching. Students will examine key SLA theories—such as interactionist and sociocultural approaches—and connect them to AI-supported learning tools. Through hands-on practice and discussion, students will explore AI tools and have opportunities to design effective, ethical AI-integrated language tasks from both learner and teacher perspectives. The course aims to build students’ AI literacy, enabling them to critically evaluate and apply AI technologies to support diverse language learning needs in both classroom and self-directed contexts.

description.zh: 本課程強調全方位的國際商用英語溝通。現今各領域上之商業活動多以英語進行，因此本課程注重發展學生以英語文進行流暢之溝通的關鍵能力，特別強調商業組織內外部常見的正式溝通之形式，包括商用英語寫作、簡報與會議技巧。課時也納入非正式溝通技巧，指導學生學習應對職場情境，因應相關之溝通需求。
description.en: This current course emphasizes a holistic view of business communication in a global context.  Given that business communication across from fields of business activities is now made possible by the English language, the course thus aims to develop the ability to use critical skills essential to successful communication in English, with particular emphases on forms of formal communications that are highly visible within and outside business organizations, including writing of business correspondence and reports, presentations and meetings. Informal communication skills are also incorporated to address workplace situations to identify the relevant communication needs.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生撰寫結構完整段落和短文之能力, 並著重如何重寫、摘要、 轉述、 陳述、筆記、編排、起草、修改等相關技巧。
description.en: This course is expected to expand students’ writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.

notes: C 組 - 學號尾號 3 的倍數，03/06/09 等，僅限英文系學生修【停開】

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括 (一) 國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
description.en: This course aims to help students build up the basic knowledge of news trans-editing and develop students’ trans-editing skills through practical training. The course covers the following areas: (1) an introduction to news trans-editing (e.g. the current state of the news trans-editing field, the production workflow, professional qualifications and personal traits of news translators); (2) strategies and skills of news trans-editing (e.g. the strategies of deletion, restructuring, abridgement and synthesis); (3) practical training of news trans-editing in a simulated or real environment.

description.zh: 文化研究以文學，社會批評，通俗文化，人類學、科學、女性主義和種族批評等觀點，對文化現象做深入的觀察、思考、及批判。本課程著重應用文化研究之豐碩成果，啟發學生認識文化問題，並培養其觀察，思考，及批判能力。不僅能因之促成社會進步，更重要的是能藉由對本國及異國文化差異及價值觀的深入瞭解，將知識應用在跨文化溝通上，協助本國企業成功地國際化。
description.en: Cultural studies is emerging as one of the most inspiring and exciting fields in and out of the academy.  Drawing its energies from literary and social criticism, popular culture, anthropology and the sciences, feminism and critiques of race, cultural studies involves an infinite number of ingenious, politically contingent, and often popularly amusing subjects.  Hopefully, students taking this course are trained to become independent, critical thinkers who are able to observe, analyze, criticize, and ameliorate culture.  By addressing diverse cultural issues, students can not only deepen their understanding of different cultural values but also apply this knowledge to improve cross-cultural communication.  One of the practical purposes of this course is to enable students to help local enterprises boost their business on the global stage of commerce.

name.zh: 文化研究與跨文化溝通

description.zh: 此進階翻譯課程旨在培養學生整合 AI 工具至翻譯流程的能力。透過結合線上翻譯計畫與先進 AI 科技，學生將於實際翻譯計畫中，學習如何運用科技來提升翻譯能力與效率。本課程著重三大主軸：（1）發展後設認知技能；（2）增強工具使用能力；（3）提升機器翻譯譯後編輯技巧。學生將參與翻譯計畫（包括維基百科、全球之聲、TED），並運用 ChatGPT 和 Claude 等 AI 工具進行批判性思考，以分析並解決翻譯過程所遇到之問題。本課程還將運用 AI 驅動工具（例如柏拉圖譜系統），來增強學生搜尋和整合翻譯資源的能力，並訓練學生如何對 AI 生成之譯文進行人工譯後編輯，以提高翻譯質量。
description.en: This advanced translation course aims to equip students with the skills necessary to integrate AI tools into their translation workflows. Through merging online translation projects with cutting-edge AI technologies, students will gain hands-on experience in using technology to improve their translation proficiency and efficiency. The course focuses on three main areas: (1) developing metacognitive skills, (2) enhancing instrumental competence, and (3) refining machine translation post-editing techniques. By engaging in online translation projects, including Wikipedia, Global Voices Lingua, and TED, students will employ AI tools, such as ChatGPT and Claude, to critically evaluate and enhance their problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Additionally, this course will bolster students’ resource-searching abilities through AI-driven tools (e.g., Platograph) and train them in manually editing AI-generated translations to enhance quality.

name.zh: AI 輔助翻譯與人機協作

description.zh: 本課程使學生熟悉混凝土之材料組成、物理及力學性質，以及混凝土之配比及其近代發展。課程中亦包含混凝土之非線性分析，如潛變、乾縮及斷裂行為等。
description.en: This course provides students with material composition, physical and mechanical properties of concrete, concrete proportion and its modern development. Courses will also be included in the nonlinear analysis of concrete, creep, shrinkage and the failure theory and so on.

description.zh: 以結構工程、大地工程、防災科學、運輸交通、營建管理、營建材料及營建技術為專題討論主題之主要範疇。
description.en: Seminar Special subject discussion of structure engineering , geography engineering pretecting calamity science, transportation, construction management , construction material and construction technique.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在土木與營建專案中進行風險與防災管理的分析與決策能力，課程內容涵蓋風險管理理論、量化分析方法、防災減災概念、法規制度、專案合約風險分攤、施工安全，以及環境與氣候韌性議題。
description.en: This course aims to equip civil engineering students with the ability to analyze and manage risk and disaster prevention throughout the lifecycle of construction and infrastructure projects. The course covers risk management theories, quantitative analysis methods, disaster mitigation principles, regulatory frameworks, contractual risk allocation, construction safety, and issues related to environmental and climate resilience.

description.zh: 妥善地利用資源可促使資源生生不息，不當地濫用卻會帶來大地反撲，禍及人類，如何在建設的同時, 大興土木之際，顧及生態體系，及為本課程之主要重點。課程內容包括環境生態系統、生態學之基本法則、質能傳遞、污染物對生態之影響。

description.en: The course describes the basic concept and confines its attention to those features of kinetics that seem to be most important for students in the field of Material Sciences and Engineering. The course covers a range from several points of view; the half life of a reactant, the time taken for half of the reactant to be consumed. Relevant of the branches of Materials Sciences, such as Biology, Chemical engineering, Electrochemistry, Inorganic chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Pharmacology, and physics are also mentioned in macroscopic kinetics investigations.

Implantables include sutures, vascular grafts, artificial heart, artificial bones and ligaments, drug delivery device, artificial tissues, artificial liver,etc. Nonimplantable materials are : cloths in medical uses,  surgical dressings and gauze, injection device, diagonsis materials, etc. Extracorporeal materials are : dialysis fibers, artificial lung, catheters, etc.

description.zh: 本課程將探討半導體材料之表面化學性質之分析技巧、以及界面和分子間引力之量測方法、表面形態分析、晶相結構分析以及電磁性質量測之技術和其原理。並配合半導體旋轉塗佈機和濺鍍機所備製之薄膜﹐實際操作 FTIR 顯微鏡、原子力顯微鏡、微量材料流變儀。
description.en: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, reology meter on the semiconductor materials.

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括 p-n 接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。
description.en: This course will introduce the material properties, the basics of solid-state physics, and semiconductor devices and physics to provide knowledge of electronic materials and modern semiconductor devices. To assess the material and device issues of electronics for practical use, analysis of the material structure and electrical performance are essential. The content will include various semiconductor device technologies, such as p-n junction, light emitted diodes (LEDs), and solar cells.

description.zh: 生質能源 (bioenergy) 指的是儲存在現有 (活著或剛失去生命) 的動植物體的能量。生質能源的來源，主要是植物將太陽能經由光合作用轉換成葡萄糖，在進一步合生物高分子衍生物 (如多醣體 (polysaccharides)) 。新一代生質能源技術強調環保技術，整合跨領域之技術，包含應用分子生物技術所發展出之基因轉殖、醱酵控制及生物觸媒技術 - 利用生物酵素進行催化化學反應達成環保及高效率與節能之目的。本課程將介紹動植物的多醣體種類及如何運用新興生物系統學的技術開發生質能源。
description.en: Bioenergy is referred to the energy stored in living or recently living biological organisms, such as animals, plants and microbes. The source of bioenergy can be traced back from plants harvesting the sunlight and converting it to glucose, then to other biopolymers such as polysaccharides. The technologies for developing bioenergy, with an emphasis on environmentally compatible, consist of gene cloning technology from molecular biology and enzymatic control and catalytic chemistry (i.e. green chemistry).  The course is an introduction course on the types of polysaccharides in animals and plants, how scientist use system biology to develop bioengergy.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則 (IFRS)，內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對 IFRS 有全面整體了解及運用之能力。亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This course is an advanced course for financial accounting. It is to teach the financial accounting theory, concept, method and procedure for students with some basic accounting knowledge. The course covers all the materials to understand financial accounting based on IFRS. The course will help students for preparing advanced license examinations for accounting.

description.zh: 人工智慧物聯網課程將物聯網的感測器與感測網路、邊緣閘道、雲端服務與存取裝置，結合機器學習、深度學習及智慧分析技術，協同建構從端到端的智慧應用，涵蓋無人商店與智慧支付、遠距醫療與照護、智慧製造與智慧家庭等多元場景。本課程著重於人工智慧在裝置與服務設計中的關鍵角色，並透過實務案例與專題討論，培養學生規劃並開發創新智慧物聯網解決方案的能力。
description.en: The AIoT course integrates sensors and sensor networks, edge gateways, cloud services, and user access devices with machine learning, deep learning, and intelligent analytics to jointly build end-to-end smart applications. These applications cover a variety of domains such as Unmanned stores and smart payment, remote healthcare and telemedicine, smart manufacturing, and smart home systems. This course emphasizes the pivotal role of AI in device and service design, and through practical case studies and project discussions, aims to equip students with the ability to plan and develop innovative intelligent IoT solutions.

name.zh: 人工智慧物聯網與應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence of Things and Applications

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

notes: 資財四甲、資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程說明如何利用質量及動量守恆建立可以描述速度、應力及壓力等流體系統物理量間關係之統制方程式。其內容包括：線及角動量守衡、應力張量、平滑近似理論、非穩態流動、邊界層近似法、線性穩定度理論及紊流系統。
description.en: We will learn how fundamental principles such as conservation of mass and momentum lead to equations that govern or describe the interrelationships of velocity, stress, pressure, and so on. Content includes macroscopic balance for linear and angular momentum, the stress tensor, lubrication approximation, unsteady flow、the boundary layer approximation, linear stability theory, and turbulent flows.

class.name: 能源光電外國學生專班

notes: 化工所和 EOMP 合開

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

notes: 資財四甲和資財所合開 / 哈佛講堂

description.zh: 影像處理、光學檢測、移動式機器人聲納避障、移動式機器人視覺控制、移動式機器人建圖、移動式機器人導航、機器臂自動物件抓取與放置、期末專題提案簡報、期末專題實驗展示、期末專題報告。
description.en: Image processing, Optical inspection, Obstacle avoidance of mobile robots with sonar, Vision-based control of mobile robots, Mobile robotic mapping, Mobile robotic navigation, Automated bin picking and placing with manipulators, Final project proposals and presentations, Final project implementation and demonstration, Final project reports.

notes: 電機大四合開, 預選限 36 人

description.zh: 本課程將介紹衛星遙測技術基礎，包括衛星通訊軟體及硬體，以及在地球科學、環境管理、農業和城市規劃中的應用。透過理論講授、案例研究和實習，學生將了解衛星遙測技術原理及其在各領域的實際應用。課程強調實際應用和解決問題的能力，並提供實習機會，讓學生參與衛星遙測專案，培養操作技能和解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course will cover the basics of satellite remote sensing technology, including satellite communication software and hardware, as well as its applications in Earth sciences, environmental management, agriculture, and urban planning. Through theoretical lectures, case studies, and practical exercises, students will gain an understanding of the principles of satellite remote sensing technology and its practical applications in various fields. The course emphasizes practical applications and problem-solving skills, providing labs for students to participate in satellite remote sensing projects and cultivate their operational skills and problem-solving abilities.

name.en: Satellite Remote Sensing Applications and Lab

notes: 電機大四合開, 預選限 40 人

description.zh: 瞭解 CMOS 超大型積體電路之電路元件特性及其組合電路之分析與設計方法，其內容包含：金氧半電晶體電路特性分析、電路性能評估、電路模擬、組合電路設計、序向電路設計、設計方法分析、測試與驗證、CMOS 案例討論與 Verilog HDL 設計等課程內容。
description.en: This course covers the electric specification, circuit analyses, and design methods of the CMOS VLSI. The contents of this course include: Circuit characterization, performance estimation, Circuit simulation, Combinational circuit, Sequential circuit, Design methodology, Testing and verification, CMOS case study, and Verilog HDL design.

description.zh: 為什麼要閱讀或研究莎士比亞? Catherine Belsey 回答道：是為了莎翁的獨特性。如她所言：「莎士比亞不僅是英語世界上流社會文化的精華，亦為其整體文化的精髓。」因為莎劇的辭彙，迄今仍通用於英語世界，並已融入日常生活之結構中。這現象不僅發生在現在的英國，自莎翁的時代開始，莎翁的語彙在全世界就從未停止流通過。何況，莎翁震撼人心的詩歌和劇場藝術，無人出其右的人性掌握，以及非凡的人生哲學思維與洞見，向來受到世人的珍愛。如世人常謂：莎士比亞的語言可觸發我們的想像力，為我們在人生的各個層面 (包括職業層面) 提升溝通效率。為了這些重要的理由，本課程將引導學生欣賞莎士比亞的若干劇作。
description.en: Why Shakespeare? Catherine Belsey answers that it is because of his singularity. As she observes, "Shakespeare is part and parcel of English-speaking culture, and not only high culture." For "phrases from the plays are still current, woven into the fabric of everyday life" in Britain now and have, in fact, been circulated in the world since the early modern era. Besides, Shakespeare has been cherished for his powerful poetry and stagecraft, his nonpareil grasp of human nature, and his remarkable philosophical insights into life. As people often observe, Shakespeare may trigger our imagination with his language and promote effective communication in every aspect of our life, including that of our careers. For these important reasons, this course aims to guide students to appreciate Shakespeare by focusing on a number of his plays.

description.zh: 本課程在研討課程設計之理論與應用。
description.en: This course is designed to develop theory and applications in English curriculum.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分，11. 級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.en: The object of this course is to introduce the students the understanding of the relationship between education and society. It presents the students with the relation between education and the main sociological theories, such as socialization, social structure, social change. It also offers students with the social condition of schools, the teacher's role, the teacher groups and the teacher's social status. After finishing this course, the students can use the knowledge learned from this course to make educational decision, analyze educational systems, study the instructional principles and solve educational problems in view of the basic theories of sociology of education, and thus lead to achieve the educational goal.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.zh: 本課程旨在教導學生： 1. 了解服務學習的意義與理念。 2. 具備規劃服務學習活動或方案的能力 3. 執行教育專業相關的服務活動與方案 4. 具備團隊合作與問題解決能力 5. 遵守教育專業人員的倫理規範 6. 反思服務的成果，增進專業成長 7. 運用個人教育專業知能服務人群 8. 透過教育服務中反省自己的教學專業知能 9. 透過教育專業服務，習得教育專業人員的服務倫理。 教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

In addition, the course is aimed to cultivate students to have educational professional ethics among the interactions with teachers and students of internship schools.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.zh: 本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解環境工程與管理之最新理論, 技術及最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the environmental engineering and management. Invited Speakers are well-known scholars in areas related to environmental engineering and management. Graduate students or thesis advisors are also invited to report research results of their graduate studies.

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之論文研究主題, 在教授個別指導下, 進行實驗之研究或模式計算, 尋找相關資料與文獻, 及獨立研究的訓練, 並將其研究成果撰寫成博士論文及發表於國際期刊。
description.en: PhD. students have to carry out independent research at Ph.D. level. Under the guidance of advisor, PhD. students will be assigned a research topic, conduct independent experimental design, data analysis, and write doctoral dissertation. To Submit papers to international journals for publication is necessary.

description.zh: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en: The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹常見電機設備與家用電器之基本構造、運作原理與系統架構，內容涵蓋電氣控制、馬達驅動、加熱元件、冷凍循環、電源轉換與基本保護機制等核心技術。透過理論講授與實例分析，使學生能將電路學、電子學與電機機械等基礎知識，應用於實際設備之功能解析與運作理解。課程將以常見電機設備（如電風扇、電鍋、吹風機、冰箱與分離式冷氣… 等）為案例，說明其電氣系統構成與控制邏輯，並介紹常見故障型態與基本診斷概念，使學生建立設備系統化分析能力與安全操作觀念。本課程強調工程應用層面的設備理解與系統思維，培養學生對電機設備之整體認識與實務判讀能力，為未來從事設備維護、能源應用或機電整合相關領域奠定基礎。
description.en: This course introduces the fundamental structure, operating principles, and system architecture of common electrical appliances and electromechanical equipment. Topics include electrical control circuits, motor drives, heating elements, refrigeration cycles, power conversion, and basic protection mechanisms. Through lectures and case-based analysis, students will apply prior knowledge from Circuit Theory, Electronics, and Electrical Machinery to understand the functional operation and system integration of practical equipment. Representative appliances—such as electric fans, rice cookers, hair dryers, refrigerators, and split-type air conditioners—are used as study cases to illustrate electrical system configuration and control logic. The course also introduces common failure modes and fundamental diagnostic concepts, enabling students to develop systematic equipment analysis skills and safe operation awareness. Emphasizing engineering-oriented application and system-level thinking,

name.en: Introduction and lab of Electrical Equipment

notes: 電機大一合開, 預選 25 人

Temporary Work 2. Fundamental Work 3. Earthwork 4. Concrete Work 5.Reinforcement Work 6.Prestressed Concrete Work 7. Steel Structure Work 8. Construction Work 9.MEP

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。 理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
description.en: This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement. The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.備註：

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程以我國智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為教材，介紹電腦軟體、醫藥、生物、中草藥之專利申請審查，以及新型專利形式審查和舉發審查。
description.en: The textbook of this course is "Patent Examination Guidelines" which is issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office. We will introduce the examination practice for special patent cases, such as computer software, medicine, biology, and Chinese herbal medicine. In addition, the examination of utility model patent and patent invalidation will also be discussed in this course.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (III)

description.zh: 本課程將探討 (1) 智財商業模式與智財交易 (2) 英美契約法 (3) 智財授權契約規範 (4) 授權程序與稽核 (5) 技術合作契約 (6) 智財合資契約及章程
description.en: This course will illustrate the following issues: (1) IP Business Model and IP Transactions, (2) Anglo-American Contract Law,  (3) Definition,  Regulation, Types & Management of IP License,  (4)License Agreement Auditing for Licensing Business, (5)  Technical Cooperation Contract, (6) IP Joint Venture Contract and Articles of Association.

name.zh: 國際智權契約與技術移轉

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略: 案例研析二
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study(II)

description.zh: 高科技產業的專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出數十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利申請策略開始，告訴同學專利申請上常見的錯誤，如何以較低的成本取得、維護我國專利，並利用我國專利進行全球專利佈局。
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the high-tech industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent filing strategy, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

name.zh: 高科技專利取得與攻防
name.en: High Tech Patent Applications and Protections

description.zh: 本課程主要包括下列主題：1. 全球企業發展的外在環境、2. 全球技術突破與創新產業、3. 各國研發創新及品牌智財策略、4.IP 產業建置、5. 全球品牌智財市場、6. 全球企業及其智財管理的規劃與移轉、7. 創新研發的保護方式、8. 協同合作與獨立作業的比較、9. 兼顧節稅的智慧財產權開發模式、10. 跨國視野下的法律議題、11. 企業智財部門規劃、12. 併購與智財授權管理、13. 品牌智財的財務價值、14. 著名全球企業智財管理模式。
description.en: This course will focus on the following topics: 1.external environments for corporate developments, 2.new technologies and innovative enterprises, 3. R&D and branding polices of major countries, 4. the establishment of IP industries, 5. global branding markets, 6. the plan and transfer of global enterprises & IP location, 7. the protection of R&D, 8.the choice between joint and individual R&D, 9. tax plan for IP development, 10.IP plan for international industries, 11, the establishment of IP department, 12.M&A and IP, 13.the evaluation of brands & IP, 14.the IP management of well-known global enterprises,

notes: 新聘專任教師; 英文授課

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

notes: 光電四、光電所選修和太空所必修合開、億光 405 教

description.zh: 衛星科技與工程導論的課程將介紹衛星系統及次系統基礎知識，以培養具有從事衛星任務設計之基礎能力。課程內容包括：衛星基本原理，衛星設計與製造，衛星運行與維護，衛星通訊與遙測應用，衛星發展趨勢。
description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

name.en: Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering

notes: 光電四、光電所和太空所合開、億光 405 教室

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

name.zh: 深度學習與太空科技應用

notes: 光電四、光電所和太空所合開、億光 405 教室

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋太空系統工程的進階課題，包括當前研究和新興技術。本課程將深入理解太空系統的設計、開發、測試和實施，著重於子系統的整合和系統性能的最佳化。主題將包括先進的材料和結構、推進系統、航電系統、控制系統、人因因素等。學生將通過案例研究、設計專案和模擬實例進行學習。
description.en: This course covers advanced topics in space systems engineering, including current research and emerging technologies. The course will provide an in-depth understanding of the design, development, testing, and implementation of space systems, with a focus on the integration of subsystems and the optimization of system performance. Topics will include advanced materials and structures, propulsion systems, avionics, control systems, human factors, and more. Students will gain hands-on experience through case studies, design projects, and simulation exercises.

notes: 光電四、光電所選修和太空所必修合開、億光 405 教

description.zh: 本課程將包含使用者經驗設計的基礎，以及使用者研究量測的內涵及方法。本課程中，將透過課堂上課、討論、以及實習的方式，介紹使用者研究的實際案例、評估模式、團隊合作方法、設計與評估工具、實踐思維、挑戰、以及實際執行的程序。預期學生將於本課程中，透過分組獲得使用者經驗在互動設計、空間設計以及產品設計上，有關使用者研究的設計、評估、施行、以及質化與量化分析量測評估的知識與方法。
description.en: This course will cover the fundamentals of user experience design and provide the students with insights into the measurement of user research. The real-life processes, challenges, considerations, tools, team works, models and case studies of user research are introduced in this course by lecturing, discussing and practicing methods. Students are expecting to learn user experience principles, to designing, evaluating, implementing and measuring user experience in both qualitative and quantitative methods in the aspect of interaction design, space design and product design individually.

name.zh: 使用者經驗設計與評量

notes: 日碩、外碩和設計博合開, 排 PBL 教室 (先鋒 / 二教 103 教室)

description.zh: 簡介，感測器，基本驅動器，順序及計時控制，PLC，伺服驅動器及放大器，基本伺服控制系統。

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

description.zh: 1. 授課目的：  現代都市計劃及都市設計作業內容中，必須考量都市永續環境生態之議題。本課程之目的即在於傳述都市之生態概念在規劃實務上之應用，並探討其作業技術內容及其行政程序，以培養學生永續都市及敷地計畫規劃能力。2. 授課內容：  由基本永續都市中，思考生態環境、人類生活環境及建築之間的相互關係。綠建築、永續都市之內容。引介各項生態技術原理及其指標講授，進而指導實證操作技術實驗並撰寫論文，再而論證其都計管制規範。3. 作業練習：  本學期藉由實驗操作、論文報告撰寫，特別著重研討式論辯，訓練學術思辯及技術應用規劃能力，以利學生認識都市生態技術及都計行政作業之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位規劃思辯能力。
description.en: This course focuses on the issues of the environmental planning, green buildings and sustainable urban design. Its major content includes: 1. Study of relation between Ecosystem, human environment and architecture, 2. essay of Green Building and Sustainable Cities, 3. The case study of Green Building design and Sustainable City Planning.

description.zh: 國際能源署 (IEA) 呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也啟動淨零目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門，建築能效評估系統 (Building energy efficiency rating system, TBERS) 為因應亞熱帶氣候與空間複合化、多樣化建築特性所量身訂做的簡易有效評估工具。為使學生培養永續淨零概念並具備建築能效評估計算、評分與標示之技術能力，具體目標如下:。1. 了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略 2. 評估新建建築、既有建築能效等級 3. 操作新建建築、既有建築之近零設計策略 4. 綜合分析與歸納建築能效機制
description.en: IEA (The International Energy Agency) proposes to set a global net carbon emission roadmap, and domestically launch a net target and action plan, targeting the building sector, the Building Energy Efficiency Rating System (TBERS) a simple and effective assessment tool tailored for subtropical climate and spatial complex and diverse building characteristics. This course aims at develop the concept of sustainable net zero and have the technical ability of building energy efficiency assessment calculation, scoring and marking, the specific goals are as follows:1. Understand domestic and foreign net zero carbon emission path strategies2. Evaluate the energy efficiency rating of new buildings and existing buildings3. Operate the nearly-zero design strategy of new buildings and existing buildings4. Conclude the analysis and induction of building energy efficiency mechanism

description.zh: 一、	從廣域範圍介紹自然生態與人文資源永續發展之道二、	藉由我國現階段環境發展策略及個案經驗，實務討論生態環境課題與措施。三、	課程內容涵蓋台灣自然與生態環境現況、森林、山坡地、農地、能源、海洋、自然保育、人文環境保育、環境法規、環境影響評估。
description.en: 1.	It will introduce the sustainable development of natural ecology and human resources through wide range.2.	It will emphasize with students to discuss the issues and strategies on environmental ecology. Those discussions will depend on national environmental development policies and special cases in recent years.3.	This course will include Taiwan nature and ecology, forest, lands lope , farmland, coastal area, natural conservation , human resources ,environmental impact assessment.

notes: 新聘兼任教師蕭驩庭授課

description.zh: 聯合國教科文組織於 1972 年通過了《世界遺產公約》，旨在保護世界文化和自然遺產，並將保護和保存文化財產的概念連結起來。五十年來，世界遺產經歷多次變革，觀念與行動與時俱進，1992 年，文化景觀概念正式確立，承認人與環境的相互作用和共生關係，縫合了長街以來自然和文化的割裂。2001 年，全球文化多樣性宣言的通過，文化在不同時代和不同地方具有各種不同的表現形式，這種多樣性的具體表現，構成人類各群體和各社會具有的獨特性和多樣化。受此影響，文化景觀、無形遺產、水下遺產、產業遺產、文化路徑、聖山遺產、天文遺產紛紛出現。本課程屬建築保存應用課程，將介紹不同主題的世界遺產案例，其目的除了引領同學認識世界遺產觀念及思潮變遷外，亦對國內文化資產保存的學習有所啟發與反省。
description.en: UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention in 1972 to protect world cultural and natural heritage and link the concepts of protection and preservation of cultural property. Over the past fifty years, World Heritage has undergone many changes, and concepts and actions have kept pace with the times. In 1992, the concept of cultural landscape was formally established, recognizing the interaction and symbiotic relationship between people and the environment, and sewing up the separation between nature and culture since the Long Street. In 2001, the Global Declaration on Cultural Diversity was adopted. Culture has different forms of expression in different times and places. The specific manifestations of this diversity constitute the uniqueness and diversity of various human groups and societies. description.zh: 本課程主要為介紹與歷史建築與古蹟之保存與再利用相關的觀念、理論、技術與發展概況，授課採講演方式。
description.en: This module introduces primarily the involved concept, theory, technique and the general conditions of its development. Class will be conducted by lecturing.

description.zh: 本課程介紹自二十世紀開始重要建築事件與作品的演變。從現代主義、粗獷主義、後現代建築到各種回應時代性的的建築思潮的發展，每週選定一個主題說明之。
description.en: The course introduces critical architectural agendas, events, and projects after 1900, from modernism, brutalism, and postmodern architecture to the development of various architectural trends that respond to the times. Each week, the course will select one topic to explain and discuss.

description.zh: 本課程預計透過專題式學習與案例分析調研，帶領學生盤點社區議題並研擬對策，建構城鄉空間的形成與社會族群的關係，並進行城鄉空間再造的提案。
description.en: This course is aimed to involve the students into the project of University Social Responsibility. By means of inventory on issues in communities and through project-based learning, this course will provide students an opportunity to understand the relationship between formation of urban spaces and social groups, then to draft a social plan, a facility plan or even a strategic guidance for further execution. From urban space reconstruction to place-making (regional revitalization), the students are expected to explore the diverse values of architectural profession and to practice the social responsibility by applying their expertise to solve real-world problems.

description.zh: 本課程培養學生職場必備的核心英文能力，主題包含英文履歷撰寫、商用英文書信、英文面試與簡報技巧、辦公室英文會話等。本課程同時加強學生基礎英文能力，如單字、文法、寫作等，並透過多元活動有系統性地發展英語溝通能力。
description.en: This course is designed to equip students with the necessary English communication skills in the workplace. The content will include English resume writing, business English, English interviews, briefing skills, and office English conversation. This course will also strengthen students’ basic English skills, such as vocabulary, grammar, and writing.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。
description.en: This course aims to help students enhance their understanding of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and current global issues, while enabling them to communicate and express their ideas effectively in English. Students will learn how to discuss global issues such as poverty, climate change, and gender equality in English, and confidently express their opinions in academic, professional, and public discussions.

name.zh: 全球及永續議題英文 (一)
name.en: English for SDGs and Global Issues I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(一)

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程將從整體產業概況出發，引導學生了解該產業的發展脈絡、市場動態等，並探討產業內的核心專業術語與表達方式。本課程旨在引導學生深入探索特定產業領域的英語應用，使其不僅能掌握專業術語，更能靈活運用於實際職場情境中。學生將逐步提升閱讀、寫作、聽力及口語表達能力，並培養跨文化溝通的敏銳度，以期在未來的國際職場中，自信且流暢地運用英語進行專業交流。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the specific industry, starting with an overview of the industry's landscape, including its development history and market dynamics. It will also delve into the core professional terminology and expressions used within the industry. The primary goal is to guide students in applying English effectively within their chosen industry, ensuring they not only grasp the technical vocabulary but can also utilize it confidently in real-world professional contexts. Students will progressively enhance their reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, while also developing a keen awareness of cross-cultural communication. This will enable them to engage in professional exchanges confidently and fluently in future international workplaces.

description.en: This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.

description.en: This course aims to enhance communicative competence with special emphasis on entrepreneurial thinking and professional English skills. From the perspectives of learning English for specific purposes (ESP) and entrepreneurship, students will learn how to create, rehearse and effectively participate in a range of different scenarios for current academic and future career pursuits.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.
