This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

name.zh: 進階全球及永續議題英文 (一)
name.en: Advanced English for SDGs and Global Issues I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(二)

description.zh: 本課程旨在進一步提升學生於學術會議與研討場合中以英語進行口頭報告、簡報發表及互動應對之能力。課程聚焦學術會議常見之發表形式，包括論文口頭發表、海報發表、研究摘要說明、短講及問答交流，並著重學術口語論述之組織、研究重點之清楚傳達、論點整合、聽眾互動與現場應答技巧。透過會議情境模擬、口頭報告、海報發表演練與回應活動，學生將強化其學術英語口語表達、簡報呈現與會議溝通能力，並建立參與國際學術交流之實務基礎。
description.en: This course aims to further develop students’ ability to deliver oral reports, conference presentations, and academic briefings in English in conference and seminar settings. It focuses on common forms of academic conference communication, including paper presentations, poster sessions, research summaries, short talks, and question-and-answer exchanges. Special emphasis is placed on organizing academic oral discourse, presenting research clearly, integrating key arguments, engaging with audiences, and responding effectively in live academic settings. Through conference simulations, oral presentation practice, poster presentation tasks, and response activities, students will strengthen their spoken academic English, presentation delivery, and conference communication skills, building a practical foundation for participation in international academic events.

name.zh: 進階學術英文發表與簡報 (一)
name.en: Advanced English for Academic Oral Reports and Presentations I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(二)

description.zh: 本課程旨在進一步提升學生以英語分析、比較與討論流行文化議題之能力，並深化其對當代文化產業與跨文化傳播的理解。課程內容涵蓋全球流行趨勢、影視與數位媒體、運動與娛樂文化、粉絲文化、名人與網紅現象、品牌與消費文化，以及青年文化與社群互動等主題，並探討流行文化與身分認同、媒體再現、商業化及全球文化流動之關聯。透過議題討論、案例分析、口頭報告、比較評論與主題簡報等活動，學生將提升英語分析與論述能力，並培養對流行文化現象之批判思考與跨文化視野。
description.en: This course further develops students’ ability to analyze, compare, and discuss issues in popular culture in English while deepening their understanding of contemporary cultural industries and cross-cultural communication. Topics include global popular trends, film and digital media, sports and entertainment culture, fan culture, celebrity and influence culture, branding and consumer culture, and youth culture in online and social spaces. Students will also explore the relationship between popular culture and identity, media representation, commercialization, and global cultural flows. Through issue-based discussion, case analysis, oral reports, comparative commentary, and thematic presentations, students will strengthen their English analytical and expressive abilities while developing critical perspectives on popular culture and its broader social and cultural impact.

name.en: Advanced English for Popular Culture I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(二)

description.zh: 本課程培養學生提供在科技領域中使用英語的能力。 學生將獲得基本的英語語言技能、詞彙、結構和科技英語的風格。 此外，該課程還強調技術和工程領域的職場溝通能力。
description.en: The first part of the one-year / two-semester course aims to develop students’ basic English competence in the context of technology. Students are expected to acquire basic English language skills, vocabulary, structures and styles of technology English. In addition, the course also emphasizes workplace communication in the field of technology and engineering.

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(三)

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(三)

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。
description.en: This course aims to help students enhance their understanding of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and current global issues, while enabling them to communicate and express their ideas effectively in English. Students will learn how to discuss global issues such as poverty, climate change, and gender equality in English, and confidently express their opinions in academic, professional, and public discussions.

name.zh: 全球及永續議題英文 (一)
name.en: English for SDGs and Global Issues I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(三)

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

name.en: English for Science, Technology, and Engineering I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(三)

description.zh: 本課程將從整體產業概況出發，引導學生了解該產業的發展脈絡、市場動態等，並探討產業內的核心專業術語與表達方式。本課程旨在引導學生深入探索特定產業領域的英語應用，使其不僅能掌握專業術語，更能靈活運用於實際職場情境中。學生將逐步提升閱讀、寫作、聽力及口語表達能力，並培養跨文化溝通的敏銳度，以期在未來的國際職場中，自信且流暢地運用英語進行專業交流。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the specific industry, starting with an overview of the industry's landscape, including its development history and market dynamics. It will also delve into the core professional terminology and expressions used within the industry. The primary goal is to guide students in applying English effectively within their chosen industry, ensuring they not only grasp the technical vocabulary but can also utilize it confidently in real-world professional contexts. Students will progressively enhance their reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, while also developing a keen awareness of cross-cultural communication. This will enable them to engage in professional exchanges confidently and fluently in future international workplaces.

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(三)

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
description.en: This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.

name.zh: 商業英文會議與簡報 (一)
name.en: English for Business Meetings and Presentations I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(三)

description.zh: 前言: 本課程主要為介紹現今主要名家與重要學派之設計理念與其實踐狀況，授課採講演與研討方式進行。內容: 瞭解設計相關理論與方法。 瞭解設計之方法與課題。 瞭解設計研究之寫作與閱讀方法。 方式: 由授課老師依不同時期，介紹所屬領域之理論、方法及參考文獻。授課方式，採講義、討論、參觀及邀請演講等方式綜合進行。為
description.en: he content of this course is to introduce the design philosophy and implementing skills of contemporary noted architects and major schools. This course will be carried on by lecturing and seminar.

name.en: Basic English for Industry Professionals I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(四)

description.zh: 本課程教授科技及商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及科技與商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎科技及商業概念、重點時事科技及商業議題、基本科技及商業字彙，和廣泛科技及商業實務用語。
description.en: This course teaches knowledge and practical applications in the fields of technology and business. Students taking this course will acquire intermediate to upper-intermediate English proficiency and basic knowledge of technology and business communication. The course content includes: fundamental technology and business concepts, key current technology and business issues, basic technology and business vocabulary, and a wide range of practical technology and business terminology.

name.en: Reading in AI and Business English I

description.zh: 本課程教授科技及商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及科技與商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎科技及商業概念、重點時事科技及商業議題、基本科技及商業字彙，和廣泛科技及商業實務用語。
description.en: This course teaches knowledge and practical applications in the fields of technology and business. Students taking this course will acquire intermediate to upper-intermediate English proficiency and basic knowledge of technology and business communication. The course content includes: fundamental technology and business concepts, key current technology and business issues, basic technology and business vocabulary, and a wide range of practical technology and business terminology.

name.en: Reading in AI and Business English I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(五)

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
description.en: This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.

name.zh: 商業英文會議與簡報 (一)
name.en: English for Business Meetings and Presentations I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(五)

description.zh: 本課程將從整體產業概況出發，引導學生了解該產業的發展脈絡、市場動態等，並探討產業內的核心專業術語與表達方式。本課程旨在引導學生深入探索特定產業領域的英語應用，使其不僅能掌握專業術語，更能靈活運用於實際職場情境中。學生將逐步提升閱讀、寫作、聽力及口語表達能力，並培養跨文化溝通的敏銳度，以期在未來的國際職場中，自信且流暢地運用英語進行專業交流。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the specific industry, starting with an overview of the industry's landscape, including its development history and market dynamics. It will also delve into the core professional terminology and expressions used within the industry. The primary goal is to guide students in applying English effectively within their chosen industry, ensuring they not only grasp the technical vocabulary but can also utilize it confidently in real-world professional contexts. Students will progressively enhance their reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, while also developing a keen awareness of cross-cultural communication. This will enable them to engage in professional exchanges confidently and fluently in future international workplaces.

name.en: Advanced English for Industry Professionals I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(五)

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。
description.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

name.zh: 進階全球及永續議題英文 (一)
name.en: Advanced English for SDGs and Global Issues I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(五)

description.zh: 本課程旨在進一步提升學生以英語分析、比較與討論流行文化議題之能力，並深化其對當代文化產業與跨文化傳播的理解。課程內容涵蓋全球流行趨勢、影視與數位媒體、運動與娛樂文化、粉絲文化、名人與網紅現象、品牌與消費文化，以及青年文化與社群互動等主題，並探討流行文化與身分認同、媒體再現、商業化及全球文化流動之關聯。透過議題討論、案例分析、口頭報告、比較評論與主題簡報等活動，學生將提升英語分析與論述能力，並培養對流行文化現象之批判思考與跨文化視野。
description.en: This course further develops students’ ability to analyze, compare, and discuss issues in popular culture in English while deepening their understanding of contemporary cultural industries and cross-cultural communication. Topics include global popular trends, film and digital media, sports and entertainment culture, fan culture, celebrity and influence culture, branding and consumer culture, and youth culture in online and social spaces. Students will also explore the relationship between popular culture and identity, media representation, commercialization, and global cultural flows. Through issue-based discussion, case analysis, oral reports, comparative commentary, and thematic presentations, students will strengthen their English analytical and expressive abilities while developing critical perspectives on popular culture and its broader social and cultural impact.

name.en: Advanced English for Industry Professionals I

class.name: 大二跨領域專業英文(四)

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調設計與人文專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service design and cultural business students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.zh: 本課程以國際時事為主軸，培養學生於英語口語互動中之理解、回應、分析與論述能力。藉由課堂討論、小組對話、議題回應、立場表述及簡短口頭報告等活動，學生將學習從多元角度理解國際事件，整理資訊、辨識觀點，並以清楚且具邏輯的英語參與討論。課程亦著重培養批判思考與國際視野，以提升學生在全球議題脈絡中之英語溝通能力。
description.en: This course centers on international current affairs and aims to develop students’ ability to comprehend, respond to, analyze, and articulate ideas in spoken English interaction. Through class discussion, small-group dialogue, issue-based responses, position statements, and short oral presentations, students will learn to approach international events from multiple perspectives, organize information, identify viewpoints, and participate in discussion in clear and logical English. The course also emphasizes the development of critical thinking and global awareness in order to strengthen students’ English communication skills in the context of global issues.

name.en: Discussion of International News and Events in English I

notes: A 組 - 學號尾號奇數，僅限英文系學生修讀，限 24 人

description.zh: 本課程以主題式口語互動為核心，培養學生在英語交流中進行有內容、具結構性且能持續延伸之口語表達能力。課程著重於學生就特定主題或議題進行意見表達、回應、追問、延伸與整合，並學習在互動中有條理地組織想法、連結觀點及建構較完整的口語交流。透過配對對話、小組討論、主題回應與短篇口語任務等活動，學生將提升其英語口語互動、自主表達與持續性溝通能力，並為後續專業領域英語簡報課程奠定基礎。
description.en: This course focuses on thematic spoken interaction and aims to develop students’ ability to engage in meaningful, structured, and sustained communication in English. Rather than emphasizing everyday conversation or formal presentation, the course trains students to express ideas, respond to others, ask follow-up questions, extend discussion, and connect viewpoints around a topic or theme. Through pair interaction, small-group discussion, topic-based response tasks, and short speaking activities, students will learn to organize ideas more clearly and participate in more coherent and extended spoken exchanges in English. The course serves as a foundation for subsequent coursework in English presentations in professional fields.

description.zh: 生物工程和醫療技術的研究和發展，在最近幾十年中，促成明確的臨床醫學和衛生保健的進步。這些領域的發展，開啟了生物工程、臨床技術和醫學信息領域課程的蓬勃發展；目前，各大學及研究所多有提供這些領域的課程。然而，大多數參與者多來自工程背景，因此學習生物科學和醫學應用於工程思維及模式，方能使得工程師和醫生之間的科學能無礙地交流。這項課程主要是為了使主修工程及材料的學生提供具有實用性的人體結構和組織的原則及相互依存的細胞和組織器官的生理系統進行有用的學習。雖然課程可能無法全然覆蓋所有生物醫學工程領域的基礎，但在這個學習過程中，我們將專注於大多數生物醫學工程以及生技和組織工程從事的主要研發領域作出努力。這門課程是醫學和工程及材料之間的橋樑。這將是促進各類工程及設計師和醫事人員之間文化和科學的交通和相互研習課程，促進生物醫學工程的創新發現和發展。在這個過程中，我們將提供一系列的生物學和醫學知識和方法，應用在工程、材料和電子領域，旨在幫助他們能將其整和連接，可以開始從工程進入生物醫學工程的專業，或者提供工程師期許能 “簡單” 理解特定臨床醫療科學和技術。經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，將結合工程及材料師長的經
description.en: Research and development in bioengineering and medical technology, conducted during recent decades, have led to spectacular progress in clinical medicine and healthcare. These achievements have triggered an enormous increase in the number courses offered in the areas of bioengineering, clinical technology and medical informatics; nowadays, most major universities offer curricula oriented towards these fields. The majority of participants however come from engineering background and so modules dealing with basic biological and medical sciences have been included, to the detriments of scientific exchanges between engineers and medical doctors. This study is primarily to give those majoring in the electronic and engineering students a useful glimpse of the principles of human structure and organization and of the interdependence of cellular and organ physiological systems. description.zh: 本課程探討智慧醫療影像與生醫訊號處理技術及其在臨床應用中的分析與判讀方法。課程涵蓋醫學影像與訊號處理的基本概念，包括影像增強、雜訊抑制、濾波、邊緣偵測、影像分割與對齊等原理與技術，以及生醫訊號之前處理與特徵擷取方法。在此基礎上，進一步介紹機器學習與深度學習於醫療影像分類、偵測與分割之應用。課程同時涵蓋模型評估指標、模型統計與可解釋性分析，以及影像 — 文字多模態模型在輔助臨床判讀中的潛力與限制。此外亦探討資料倫理、隱私治理與主權 AI 等議題，使學生了解醫療影像模型部署於實際場域時所面臨的挑戰。
description.en: This course explores intelligent medical imaging and biomedical signal processing techniques, along with their analytical and interpretive methods in clinical applications. It covers fundamental concepts of medical image and signal processing, including the principles and techniques of image enhancement, noise suppression, filtering, edge detection, image segmentation, and registration, as well as biomedical signal preprocessing and feature extraction methods. Building upon this foundation, the course further introduces the application of machine learning and deep learning to medical image classification, detection, and segmentation. It also addresses model evaluation metrics, model statistics, interpretability analysis, and the potential and limitations of image–text multimodal models in assisting clinical interpretation. In addition, topics such as data ethics, privacy governance, and sovereign AI are discussed, enabling students to understand the challenges of deploying medical ima

Therefore, the student has the design capability of analog filter integrated circuit. The contents of this course: 1. Introduction 2.LNA 3.Mixer 4.Oscillators 5.Frequency Synthesizers 6.Power Amplifier 7.Analog Baseband Signal Processing

notes: 希望不排在六教，限 25 人，小教室

description.en: This course is concerned with the mixed-signal integrated circuit design. Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of mixed-signal CMOS integrated circuits, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1.Introduction to mixed-signal design 2.Continuous-time filters 3.Switched-capacitor filters 4.witched-current filters 5.D/A converters 6.A/D conerters 7.Oversampled Sigma-Delta A/D coverters 8.Pipelined A/D converter 9.Layout for mixed-signal integrated circuit

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於提供修課學生計算機視覺之基本知識，並引導學員認識 Android 開發概念，以及計算機視覺程式之設計方法，其設計工具將是使用 OpenCV 及 Eclipse 開發工具為主。課程內容分別如下：(1) 影像與視訊的組成 (2) 低階視覺之影像處理 (3) 影像轉換 (4) 影像檢索及分類 (5) 影像輪廓與紋理解析 (6) 影像分割與聚類 (7) 運動分析與追蹤 (8) 相機模型與矯正 (9) 取樣模型及三維建構 (10) 圖形辨識概述與實作 (11) 電腦視覺技術為基礎之 Android 行動裝置設計 (12) 低階視覺影像處理之 Android 行動裝置設計 (13) 影像輪廓與紋理解析之 Android 行動裝置設計 (14) 影像特徵擷取之 Android 行動裝置設計 (15) Android 裝置上之即時動態影像處理
description.en: This course includes fundamental and advanced topics in computer vision with a focus on image recognition, machine learning, and applied computer vision principles for Android devices. Advanced topics in computer vision including scene modeling, 3D reconstruction, motion analysis, object tracking, pattern recognition, and mobile computer vision, with embedded Android devices. These subjects could be taken in either order. (1) Image and video formation (2) Low-level visual processing(3) Image transforms(4) Image categorization(5) Contour and texture analysis(6) Segmentation and grouping(7) Motion analysis and visual tracking(8) Camera models and calibration(9) Scene modeling and 3D reconstruction(10) Pattern recognition(11) Mobile computer vision on Android devices(12) Low-level visual processing with Android (13) Contour and texture analysis with Android (14) Feature Detection with Android(15) Real-time computer vision on Android

description.zh: 本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，包含：有線及無線網路的內容介紹，以及整合有線及無線網路成為異質網路的概念，其中將針對 IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH) 教導學生針對異質網路垂直切換的原理及技術。最後，對於多媒體服務技術及原理做介紹，包含：VoIP 服務以及視訊串流服務的介紹，以及如何針對 多種異質網路整合多媒體服務的介紹，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。
description.en: This course introduces the characteristics and architecture of multimedia service in heterogeneous network environment. First, wired and wireless networks, e.g., 3G/3.5G/4G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other popular wireless access techniques, would be introduced one by one. Then, by describing the theory and technology of IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH), this course would show how to integrate multiple different networks into heterogeneous network environments and how to handoff among them. Finally, regarding multimedia service, VoIP and video streaming services would be taken into consideration. This course would introduce how to provide multimedia services over heterogeneous network environment. Therefore, students can learn the next-generation techniques about multimedia services in heterogeneous network environment from this course.

name.en: Multimedia Service in Heterogeneous Network Environment

description.zh: 生物工程和醫療技術的研究和發展，在最近幾十年中，促成明確的臨床醫學和衛生保健的進步。這些領域的發展，開啟了生物工程、臨床技術和醫學信息領域課程的蓬勃發展；目前，各大學及研究所多有提供這些領域的課程。然而，大多數參與者多來自工程背景，因此學習生物科學和醫學應用於工程思維及模式，方能使得工程師和醫生之間的科學能無礙地交流。這項課程主要是為了使主修工程及材料的學生提供具有實用性的人體結構和組織的原則及相互依存的細胞和組織器官的生理系統進行有用的學習。雖然課程可能無法全然覆蓋所有生物醫學工程領域的基礎，但在這個學習過程中，我們將專注於大多數生物醫學工程以及生技和組織工程從事的主要研發領域作出努力。這門課程是醫學和工程及材料之間的橋樑。這將是促進各類工程及設計師和醫事人員之間文化和科學的交通和相互研習課程，促進生物醫學工程的創新發現和發展。在這個過程中，我們將提供一系列的生物學和醫學知識和方法，應用在工程、材料和電子領域，旨在幫助他們能將其整和連接，可以開始從工程進入生物醫學工程的專業，或者提供工程師期許能 “簡單” 理解特定臨床醫療科學和技術。經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，將結合工程及材料師長的經
description.en: Research and development in bioengineering and medical technology, conducted during recent decades, have led to spectacular progress in clinical medicine and healthcare. These achievements have triggered an enormous increase in the number courses offered in the areas of bioengineering, clinical technology and medical informatics; nowadays, most major universities offer curricula oriented towards these fields. The majority of participants however come from engineering background and so modules dealing with basic biological and medical sciences have been included, to the detriments of scientific exchanges between engineers and medical doctors. This study is primarily to give those majoring in the electronic and engineering students a useful glimpse of the principles of human structure and organization and of the interdependence of cellular and organ physiological systems. Although it is no possible to cover all of the biomedical engineering domains in this course, we will have made an e

description.zh: 本課程以國際時事為主軸，培養學生於英語口語互動中之理解、回應、分析與論述能力。藉由課堂討論、小組對話、議題回應、立場表述及簡短口頭報告等活動，學生將學習從多元角度理解國際事件，整理資訊、辨識觀點，並以清楚且具邏輯的英語參與討論。課程亦著重培養批判思考與國際視野，以提升學生在全球議題脈絡中之英語溝通能力。
description.en: This course centers on international current affairs and aims to develop students’ ability to comprehend, respond to, analyze, and articulate ideas in spoken English interaction. Through class discussion, small-group dialogue, issue-based responses, position statements, and short oral presentations, students will learn to approach international events from multiple perspectives, organize information, identify viewpoints, and participate in discussion in clear and logical English. The course also emphasizes the development of critical thinking and global awareness in order to strengthen students’ English communication skills in the context of global issues.

name.en: Discussion of International News and Events in English I

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀，限 24 人

description.zh: 本課程以主題式口語互動為核心，培養學生在英語交流中進行有內容、具結構性且能持續延伸之口語表達能力。課程著重於學生就特定主題或議題進行意見表達、回應、追問、延伸與整合，並學習在互動中有條理地組織想法、連結觀點及建構較完整的口語交流。透過配對對話、小組討論、主題回應與短篇口語任務等活動，學生將提升其英語口語互動、自主表達與持續性溝通能力，並為後續專業領域英語簡報課程奠定基礎。
description.en: This course focuses on thematic spoken interaction and aims to develop students’ ability to engage in meaningful, structured, and sustained communication in English. Rather than emphasizing everyday conversation or formal presentation, the course trains students to express ideas, respond to others, ask follow-up questions, extend discussion, and connect viewpoints around a topic or theme. Through pair interaction, small-group discussion, topic-based response tasks, and short speaking activities, students will learn to organize ideas more clearly and participate in more coherent and extended spoken exchanges in English. The course serves as a foundation for subsequent coursework in English presentations in professional fields.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹供應鏈管理中之相關問題及議題 。其中包含產業分析、e 化概念、需求及供應管理、長鞭效應、存貨管理、延遲理論、及供應鏈管理實務。
description.en: The purpose of the course is to offer student a sound introduction of supply chain management relative issues. It includes industry analysis, E-business concept, demand and supply management, bullwhip effect, inventory management, postponement, and supply chain management practice.

description.zh: 在本課程中，同學將學習到計算機程式語言 Python 基礎與應用，建立 Python 程式設計的基本概念。透過做中學、學中做，建構程式設計的基礎，以及基本程式運算邏輯，以培養運算思維、動手做的能力。期末以分組方式完成一個與學生專業領域相關應用的專題，學習如何運用程式解決與自身相關領域運用上的問題。
description.en: In this course, students will learn the basics and applications of the Python programming language and establish the basic concepts of Python programming design. Through the continuous practice, student will construct the basic logic of the program design, and the ability of computation think and practice application. At the final, a topic related to the application of students' professional subjects will be completed in groups, and student will learn how to use the program to solve problems in the relevant fields.

description.en: This course is designed to help student to learn another skill, better understand technology, enrich there live and inspire their interests for further study. The course includes: 1.basic knowledge of computer; 2.the application of computer; 3.data procession; 4.data control; 5.internet; 6.multimedia; 7.computer virus; 8. the world of information.

notes: 自然與科學向度, 計中電腦教室

description.zh: 學習相似於 Microsoft Power Point 的「拖 - 拉 - 點 - 選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code 程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫 APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP 的邏輯流程與 UI (使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的 APP! 課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的 Homework (實作型作業)。經此系統化訓練，在 APP 的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。「讓不懂 IT (資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的 APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

notes: 創新與創業向度, 計中電腦教室

notes: 創新與創業向度, 計中電腦教室

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生如何運用創意編程和視覺化電腦圖形技術，將資料及音訊數據轉換為可視化之 2D 或 3D 視覺內容，藉以增進資料及音訊之閱聽體驗。課程進行中，學生將習得多種基於演算法之視覺表現方式，以滿足設計層面中富含躍動感、平衡感以及美感之體驗需求，活用創意編程與新媒體技術來創建更生動、更具有影響力的動靜態視聽影像。
description.en: This course aims to teach students how to utilize the knowledge from data science and computer graphics technology to represent data and audio into visualized 2D/3D representations, which gives rise to enhanced experiences of reading and listening. Students will learn a variety of programming skills to design visual representation based on algorithms to deliver dynamic, balanced and aesthetic experiences. With the help of creative coding and new media technology, more vivid and influential static and dynamic visual and audio experiences will be generated.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討當前重要教育議題，如: 藝術與美感教育、性別教育、人權教育、勞動教育、法治教育、生命教育、品德教育、多元文化教育、新移民教育、原住民教育、媒體素養教育、生涯發展教育、環境教育、藥物教育、性教育、國際教育等各類教育議題。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: The course is aimed to provide current issues in education, such as: artistic and aesthetic education, gender education, human rights education, labor education, legal education, life education, moral education, multicultural education, new immigrants education, aboriginal education, media literacy education, career development education, environmental education, drug education , sex education , international education and other education issues.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.zh: 講授工程圖之基本原理及規則，並佐以必要之工程設計知識與 AutoCAD 繪圖技巧, 培養學生具備熟練與有效率地將設計構想以工程圖方式正確表達的能力。
description.en: An introductory course providing the student with fundamental information, understanding and skills mainly in orthographic projection. Theories and principles of engineering drawing will be specifically introduced and concurrent with the practice of drafting for industrial design.

description.zh: 掌握形式從屬機能旨意，熟悉施作技術限制與創意可行性，學習從設計到實作的落實，透過各種機械設備操作、加工技術學習，實際接觸及操作真實材料，了解材料種類、性質、加工過程、組裝知識、技術與美學等，以呈現設計作品之原型與成品。
description.en: Based on “Form follows Function”, student will learn interacts and limitations among technology feasibility and creative application, in order to master sequential implementations form design ideas to real works. Students are required to operate various mechanical equipment and processing technologies, thus to realize the types and nature of the materials, processing procedure, as well as the assembly of knowledge, technologies and aesthetics to format intended design prototypes and establishments.

notes: 家室組 (木工廠)，請勿選錯組

description.zh: 應用設計手繪工具與技法於各種設計作品圖面呈現，培養學生對空間、形體、材質、介面、裝置、比例等簡潔繪畫技巧與圖示性設計圖表達能力。
description.en: Students will learn to sketch by hand in various tools and technologies on design drawings. The simple painting tips as, spatial perceptive, presentation of form and materials, interfaces media types and installations, and proportion as well as abilities of the infographic design presentation will be taught in this class.

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

description.zh: 跨領域專業英文課程旨在提高學生以英語文進行跨領域交流的能力。課程內容將整合語言學習與專業領域應用，培養學生在閱讀、寫作、聽力和口語等方面的綜合能力，使學生能夠在跨領域的學術和職場環境中進行有效溝通。
description.en: The interdisciplinary ESP courses aim to strengthen students’ ability to communicate effectively in cross-disciplinary contexts. The curriculum integrates language learning with subject-specific knowledge, enhancing students’ proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Through these courses, students will develop the confidence and competence to engage successfully in both academic and professional interdisciplinary environments.

description.zh: 針對學生之學習研究心得報告，集體討論，以訓練學生研究之能力。
description.en: Group Discussion.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或理論論文寫作之能力。研究方法一強調研究素養及理念設計，課程內容包含研究的基本概念、文獻探討、研究問題、研究變項、研究假設、研究設計、資料蒐集與分析、研究工具、研究樣本、研究倫理與研究論文撰寫等。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This research methods one focus on research literacy and conceptual design that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis, research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

notes: 排一般教室, 限本系生 25 人修

description.zh: 本課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有全面性的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、理論與實務基礎、互動設計方法與技術、科技支援與應用、認知心理、情境設計以及電腦支援協同合作等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。
description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, interaction design methods and techniques, technical support and application, cognitive psychology, scenario design and CSCW. Course also incorporates case studies and company visits to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

notes: 排一般教室, 限本系生修課, 人數上限 25 人

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或理論論文寫作之能力。研究方法一強調量化研究，課程內容包含研究的基本概念、文獻探討、研究問題、研究變項、研究假設、研究設計、資料蒐集與分析、研究工具、研究樣本、研究倫理與研究論文撰寫等。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of the definition of the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis.

notes: 排一般教室, 限本系生 15 人修

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct  multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation. The teachin

name.en: Special Topics on Interactive Media Design (I)

notes: 限本系生 15 人修 (交換生勿選)

description.zh: 本課程內容涵蓋次世代定序技術之基因體大數據、電子健康紀錄資料與醫電訊號實作與分析，將學習定序資料之分析流程與工具、病歷資料庫使用和訊號處理、特徵擷取與機器學習等應用。
description.en: This course covers genomic big data from next-generation sequencing technologies, electronic health record data, and biomedical signal processing and analysis. Students will learn sequencing data analysis pipelines and tools, the use of clinical databases, and applications of signal processing, feature extraction, and machine learning.

name.zh: 智慧醫療大數據實作與分析
name.en: Smart Healthcare Big Data Implementation and Analysis

description.zh: 訓練學生應用統計套裝軟體進行資料整理、陳列、分析、解釋及統計推論，以建立學生使用統計套裝軟體進行統計資料分析之能力。課程主題包括敘述統計之圖表製作、假設檢定、信賴區間、變異數分析和迴歸模型。學期末，學生應能以標準統計分析程序，分析商業資料，並根據統計分析之結果，建議可行之企業決策。
description.en: This course reviews and expands upon core topics in probability andstatistics through the study and practice of data analysis. Topicsinclude numerical and graphical summaries of data, hypothesis testing,confidence intervals, analysis of variance, and regression. Uponcompletion of this course, students should be able to think criticallyabout data and apply standard statistical inference procedures to drawconclusions from such analysis.

name.en: Statistical Data Analysis Using Computer Software

description.zh: 本課程將涵蓋電腦科學的理論基礎。其內容包含自動機理論，電腦語言學，以及計算形式等。電腦相關的基本數學也將涵蓋在課程範圍之中。包括集合論，基本關係及及操作，以及理論證明工具與技術。課程大綱: 基礎理論介紹，有限狀態自動機 / 一般敘述語法，Regular 集合的基本性質，前後文無相關文法， Pushdown 自動機，杜林機（turning machines），Chomsky 層次結構，基本關係及操作，理論證明技術及工具。
description.en: This course will look the theoretical foundation in computer science.  Automata theory, languages, and computation formalism will be examined in details.  Various fundamental computer-related mathematics will also be covered.  They include, sets/subsets, basic relations and operations and tools/techniques for proving theorems. Course Outline: Introduction to Theoretical Foundations, Finite Automata / Regular Expression, Properties of Regular Sets, Context-Free Grammars, Pushdown Automata, Turing Machines, The Chomsky Hierarchy (tentative), Basic Relations and Operations, Tools/Techniques for Proving Theorems.

notes: 資工所、電資外生所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 1. 程序同步 2. 同作機制 3. 虛擬記憶體 4. 分散式系統 5. 分散式同作控制   6. 電腦安全 7. 排程模式
description.en: 1. Process synchronization 2. Concurrency Mechanisms 3. Virtual memory 4. Distributed Systems 5. Distributed Concurrency Control 6. Queuing Models

notes: 資工所、電資外生所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 嵌入式系統目前愈來愈普遍。它將會大大地影響我們的生活方式。可攜式裝置如智慧型手機、掌上型電腦、以及所謂的 IA 裝置如家用網路閘道器、數位視訊錄影機、和常見的遊戲機都是屬於嵌入式系統的範疇。在本課程中, 我們將會討論何謂嵌入式系統、嵌入式系統的形式、以及如何建構一個嵌入式系統。由於嵌入式系統包含硬體及軟體的議題，我們也會探討相關的主題。 本課程的先修課程包含計算機組織與結構、C 程式語言、資料結構、系統程式、以及作業系統。課程主要內容如下：嵌入式系統簡介與概論、嵌入式精簡指令集結構、ARM 指令集、嵌入式計算平台、嵌入式程式設計與分析、嵌入式作業系統、系統設計技術、裝置操作、網路。本課程亦包含實習與學期專題作業。
description.en: Embedded systems are more and more popular today. It will affect the human life greatly. Portable devices like smart phone, PDA, and MP3 player, and so-called IA devices such as home gateway, DVR, and game machine are all categorized as embedded systems. In this course, we will discuss what an embedded system is, what it looks like, and how to build an embedded device. Since an embedded system involves hardware and software issues, we will discuss the related subjects. The prerequisite courses for this class include computer organization and architecture, the C programming language, data structure, system programming, and operating system. The major topics of this course are listed as follows: Introduction and Basic Concepts, The RISC Embedded Architectures, The ARM instruction Set, The Embedded Computing Platforms, Program Design and Analysis, The Embedded Operating Systems, System Design Techniques, Device Manipulation, Networks.

notes: EMI, 資工四、資工所和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 本課程在介紹電腦視覺的基本概念與使用技術. 課程內容包含: 1.introduction to computer vision 2.geometric camera calibration 3.illumination 4.geometry of multiple view 5.structure from motion 6.segmentation by clustering 7.tracking models 8.model-based vision 9.image-based rendering.
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques of computer vision. The outline of this course includes: 1.introduction to computer vision 2.geometric camera calibration 3.illumination 4.geometry of multiple view 5.structure from motion 6.segmentation by clustering 7.tracking models 8.model-based vision 9.image-based rendering.

notes: 資工所和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 本課程可使學生瞭解：貨幣與資金市場、投資問題、如何取得資金與運用資金、使公司價值最大、使股東權益最大化、瞭解代理制度、瞭解公司股票、債務之利用，股利政策等事項・
description.en: This course has provided: money and capital market、Investments 、How to obtaining and using funds、Maximize the value o their firms、How to maximize stockholders' stock、To know agency problem 、To know the price of the firm's stock, use of debt and dividend policy.

notes: 經管所和 IMBA 合開

notes: 經管所、資財所和 IMBA 合開

description.zh: 金融科技包含兩個字，金融與科技，是近年來新興的產業趨勢，影響的層面非常廣泛，不只是金融方面，更牽涉到新興科技與物聯網。本課程將從不同的角度分析金融科技的技術內容、應用領域及商業模式，並藉智慧財產權與國內外重要公司發展的得失做一介紹，希望達到了解並運用此新興科技的目的。
description.en: FinTech includes two words: Finance and Technology. It is a new trend of industrial field. It has influence on lot of technical fields, not only finance, but also emerging technologies and IoT. This course will analyze FinTech from different angles, such as technology contents, application fields and business models. It also will utilize intellectual property and experience of FinTech leading companies to obtain decent knowledge of this new field.

notes: 資財所和 IMBA 合開 / 全英語

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督 / 非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function 多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估 (Accuracy Assessments) 及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

notes: 電機所和電資外生所合開, 預選 50 人

description.zh: 讓學生對於模糊邏輯、模糊推論有一整體性了解，並對於將模糊邏輯在控制工程之應用具有理論與軟體撰寫之能力。

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及 "納米" 對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 引擎型式及運轉，引擎循環之理想模式，引擎設計及運轉之重要參數，燃料空氣混合之熱力學分析，工作流體的特性，實際引擎循環，引擎燃燒現象及分析，污染控制，引擎控制介紹引擎性能及特性分析。

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國 95 年 2 月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology.The 'Defense Mobilization' unit explores the meaning and functions of nationwide defense mobilization, emphasizing its importance to national security. It also introduces the concept of youth service mobilization, helping students understand the role they play within the national defense mobilization system. Through this, students cultivate a sense of patriotism and deepen the collective consensus on national defense.

description.zh: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解信號與系統之基本概念及分析方法，以作為控制，通訊，電子電路，濾波器設計及數位信號處理等課程修習之基礎。課程內容包含：(1) 標準訊號及訊號表示法 (2) 連續系統的數學分析 (3) 離散系統的數學分析 (4) 拉氏轉換分析 (5) Z- 轉換分析 (6) 傅立葉分析 (7) 工程應用。
description.en: course title : signals and systemsdescription : this course contains the properties of signals , systems , LTI systems , and basis linear transforms . this is a basic course in the field of control and communication .

description.zh: 1. 簡介 2. 數學基礎	- 機率	- 隨機程序：自相關函數與功率密度函數，高斯程序、白雜訊	- 正交開展與線性濾波	- 取樣與量化 3. 最佳接收器設計	- 信號的幾何表示	- 最大事後機率與最大可能接收原理	- 相配濾波器	- 錯誤機率 4. 數位調變與多工技術	- 數位調變：振幅移鍵調變、相位移鍵調變、四相振幅調變、頻率移鍵調變	- 數位調變的取捨條件：錯誤機率、功率、頻寬與複雜度	- 多工技術：分頻多工、分時多工、分碼多工 5. 消息理論簡介	- 源編碼與熵	- 通道編碼與通訊容量

description.zh: 本課程介紹有限元素分析法基本原理及其在各種工程問題上之應用。包含有限元素分析法之基本觀念，利用變分原理建立有限元素模式，形狀函數及等參數元素，一維問題：桿、桁架、樑及骨架等，二維問題：平面應力應變及板殼問題。三維問題：一般實體，有限元素分析之計算機程式處理，有限元素分析於動態問題之應用，相關有限元素分析套裝軟體簡介

Topics include Variational Formulation and Finite Element Formulations, 1-D, 2-D and 3-D Element Shapes, Numerical Integration, Applications to dynamic problem and Introduction to Commercial Finite Element Programs.

description.zh: 課程內容包括：課程分為三部分，第一、接合技術之基礎：材料表面結構和接合力學。第二、介紹一般工程用接合技術：機械接合、銲接、銲接冶金、軟硬銲、金屬 - 陶瓷接合、擴散鍵結、和膠合。第三、接合應用：真空系統和微電子接合和密封結構介紹。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first three chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of joining, including: Introduction, Surface science, and The mechanics of joining. The next six chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the joining and assembly of the components of an engineering system, including: Mechanical bonding, Welding, Welding Metallurgy, Soldering & Brazing, Metal-Ceramic Joints & Diffusion Bonding, Adhesives, and Structural Adhesives. The last two chapters take two areas of special interest, vacuum system and microelectronics, and survey the range of resolutions to joining problems which have been developed for these specific application.

notes: 機電所、製科所和智慧鐵道學程合開

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生探討基本室內環境品質與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：1. 以各種類型的建築室內環境為主題；2. 探討人為環境與人體健康之關係；3. 探討建築材料、構造與設備對室內環境各項因子之影響；4. 學習室內環境品質量測儀器之操作與判讀能力；5. 具備診斷與改善一般室內環境議題之相關專業知識及操作能力。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to discuss the relationship between Indoor Environment Quality and human healthy, and make sure our students can realize the knowledge of healthy environment and manage it.Contents：1. The indoor environment of different types of building.2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.3. Discuss the influence of the building material, construction and equipment on indoor environment.4. Learn to use the instrument to measure indoor environment quality.5. Learn to diagnose and improve indoor environment quality.

notes: 建都碩和設計博班合開

description.zh: 當 Lumiere 兄弟於 1895 年末在巴黎一家咖啡館, 舉辦第一場售票的電影放映會時, 也正是全球第二次工業革命如火如荼影響人們的生產方式與都市生活之際, 透過紀錄當代都市活動與工業化機械美學的短片, 他們讓電影技術與城市發展從最初就密不可分, 共同作為歌頌現代性的重要媒介。然而, 學術界要遲到約莫百年之後, 從 1990 年代開始才逐漸形成專門探討電影與城市互動關係的跨學門領域。來自電影研究、都市研究、地理學、歷史學、比較文學、區域研究?? 等等領域的學者們, 於過去三十數年間替電影城市研究貢獻心力。他們不只是藉由電影分析與相關史料爬梳來重新理解現代性、現代主義與當代都市的發展, 也同時關注於二次大戰後流行的黑色電影 (film noir) 如何將當時的都市議題作為其創作主題, 後續於 1970 年代起流行的各種近未來反烏托邦電影, 又是怎麼進一步藉由預測人類都市的發展來反思當下, 創造電影與城市間更為複雜的互文關係。千禧年之後, 隨著電影工業與市場的全球化, 電影逐漸成為具有都市行銷潛力的大眾媒體, 電影場景更逐步發展成一個重要的觀光類型。同時因為電影技術門檻降低與社群媒體的發展, 電影也不再只是電影公司或具有天份的獨立電影工作者的遊戲, 更多難以分類的影像對都市空間進
description.en: While cinema has been invented over a hundred years and getting influential in shaping people’s perspectives to our environments, the studies of cinematic urbanism have only initiated since 1990s. During the past decades, this interdisciplinary field has developed upon the scholarships of various disciplines, including film and media studies, cultural studies, history, geography, urban studies, etc. This course intends to introduce this still young field through chronologically examining the relationships between cinema and cities, from both being used to celebrate and mediate the modern feelings,to film noir playing a crucial role to criticize and depict urban problems, and to cinematic urban imaginaries boosting tourism and intervening in urban process. Students will learn the theories and methodologies of cinematic urbanism studies, comprehending cinema and different urban spaces as powerful medium that could be manipulated to create, transmit, and perceive certain ideologies.

notes: 建都碩和設計博班合開

description.zh: 資訊都市主義（informatical urbanism 或 informational urbanism）為一跨領域學科，旨在透過資訊環境與流程之輔助，推動政策、規劃、發展、策略行動、設計之都市與社區進程。本課程主要在協助學生，以都市與社區問題為基本導向，建立資訊環境與流程之規劃能力。授課主要涵蓋面向：1. 資訊與知識基礎設施 2. 經濟面向 3. 都市治理與公共行政 4. 都市空間之資訊化 5. 地點因子 6. 使用者行為 7. 特殊議題。
description.en: Informatical urbanism (or informational urbanism) is an interdisciplinary area of knowledge, and it mainly utilize the facilitation of informatical environments and procedures for the progression of policy, planning, development, strategic initiative, and design within cities and communities.During this course, student will acquire the planning capability of establish such applicable informatical environments and procedures, based upon explorations of urban and community issues.Main contents of this course: 1. Information and knowledge infrastructures, 2. Economic aspects, 3. Urban governance and administration, 4. Informaticalization of urban space, 5. Location factors, 6. User behavior, 7. Focus area of problem.

notes: 建都碩和設計博班合開

description.zh: 本課程介紹整合即時影像、即時音訊、實體裝置、及相關表演科技（如燈光控制、各類感應器應用等）之技術與應用實務，並藉由圖形化、物件導向程式設計系統，引導未有程式設計經驗的視覺設計者或輔助已有程式設計能力者，以更有效率的方式進行相關互動系統設計，藉以達成互動裝置、表演科技、與表演藝術之整合。
description.en: This course introduces the technology that help integrates real-time video, audio, installations, and associated performance arts technology (such as lighting control, the application of various types of sensors, etc.) into performing arts. Through a graphical, object-oriented programming system, the course is intended to help visual designers with no programming experiences or to assist experienced programmers to efficiently design the interactive systems that combine interactive installations, performance arts technology, and performing arts itself as a whole.

name.en: Interactive Installation and Performing Arts Technology

notes: 日碩、外碩班和設計博班合開, 排一般教室, 限 40 人

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於培養學生具備以下的能力：1. 使學生具備能夠把「抽象概念」轉換成實務設計的基本能力。2. 培養學生有美感欣賞與基本應用技巧的能力。3. 訓練學生具有獨立思考與解決問題的視覺構成能力。4. 具備認識感官資訊處理過程以及傳遞原理的基本能力。5. 能了解視覺、聽覺以及空間互動資訊如何運作以及應用的能力。6. 學習如何運用相關的方法、整合相關專業知識與技能於資訊設計上。
description.en: This course is expected to train students to be equipped with the following abilities: 1. Ability to transforming the abstract ideas into practical design. 2. Ability of aesthetic appreciation and basic application skills. 3. Visual construction ability of independent thinking and problem-solving. 4. Understanding of perceived information processing and communication principle. 5 Understanding of knowledge and application of visual, acoustic and spacial interaction information. 6. Learning how to apply relevant methods and integrate knowledge and techniques to practical information design.

notes: 日碩、外碩和設計博合開, 光華 409, 本系限碩一修【停開】

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討生活環境設計之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所結合設計、藝術、人文、木工等各領域的學生，整合培育創新設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具各種專長的研究生，協同完成生活環境設計專題的研究，或是透過生活環境設計個案研討、生活環境設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: The objective of this course is to discuss research topics related to living environment design, focusing on literature study, thesis study and discussion and case studies, through intensive discussion, written report and research and practice of design topics, students can exchange opinions efficiently, gain more in-depth and extensive experience, and have the ability to research, analyze and practice. Therefore, another major learning objective of this course is to construct a multi-field interactive learning environment, which can be combined with graduate students with various specialties to collaborate on research on living environment design topics, or through case studies on living environment design. Teaching will focus on classroom lectures, thesis discussions and presentations, and thematic facts, and will be evaluated by reports, group discussions and presentations, and practical works.

name.en: Special Topics on Living Environment Design

notes: 創新所和設計博班合開；預選上限 15 人

description.zh: Brundtland 報告在 1987 年將永續發展定義為「在不損害後代子孫滿足其自身需求的能力的前提下滿足當前需求的發展。」17 個永續發展目標依循千禧年共同訂定發展目標的成功基礎上延展，其中包括諸如氣候變化，經濟不平等，創新，可持續消費，和平與正義等新領域。17 個永續發展目標更於 2016 年 1 月成為聯合國致力發展推動政策及生效直至 2030 年。本課程旨在探討研究「永續發展」新概念和理論基礎。課程論述著重於工業化國家（尤其是台灣地區）的永續性問題，例如人口老齡化，可持續消費等。課程中透過創新產品設計與開發方法來系統化引導學生探索有關可持續性，經濟和技術層面以及相關知識社會學，並嘗試帶領學生提出具可行性的新產品、系統及服務概念，為當前狀態下提供更好的友善環境解決方案。課程期待學生透過修習該課程，應可以掌握跨學科永續發展的設計原理，並教導如何藉由創新產品設計和開發方法來引導不同永續相關背景和設計背景的專業人員合作以瞭解開發市場上成功之環境友善產品之關鍵課題，針對環境需求，提出創新友善環境解決方案並進而產生創新環境友善產品。
description.en: Sustainable development is defined by Brundtland Report (1987) as “development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.” There are 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) build on the successes of the Millennium Development Goals, while including new areas such as climate change, economic inequality, innovation, sustainable consumption, peace and justice, among other priorities. The 17 SDGs came into effect in January 2016, and they will continue to guide UNDP policy and funding until 2030. This course aims to explore alternative conceptions and theoretical underpinnings of the notion of “sustainable development.” It focuses on the sustainability problems of industrial countries, especially in Taiwan such as aging of populations, sustainable consumption, etc. It intends to use IPDD approach systematically to explore the sociology of knowledge around sustainability, the economic and technological dimensions a

notes: 創新所和設計博班合開

description.zh: 先修課程：3002014 或負責教授同意。一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導、對流原理、強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式、輻射熱傳遞、凝結與沸騰、熱交換器、熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

description.zh: 機器人學概述、機器人運動學、路徑規劃、機器人避障、機器人視覺、任務規劃、機器人動力學與控制系統
description.en: English Description  General Induction, Manipulator Kinematics, Trajectory Planning, Collision Avoidance, Robot Vision, Task Planning,Manipulator Dynamics and Control

notes: 電機所、自動化所、電資外生所、械械外生和創新 AI 合開

Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: 籃球 (選)※以組隊方式選課，洽蔣憶德老師，分機 3321

description.zh: 本課程旨在經由對文化經濟學的認知，解讀文化經濟的發展邏輯與運行機制，建構文化經濟知識體系，期能為文化市場與文化產業發展提供理論基礎與思維座標。課程主要內容，一為在經濟邏輯運行下的文化活動，諸如文化產品、文化事業、文化資本、文化產業、文化市場等；另一為經濟活動所反映與體現的文化因素，以及對經濟運行產生作用的思維價值等。
description.en: The course aims through awareness of cultural economics to interpret the development logic and operating mechanism of cultural economy and to construct a cultural economic knowledge system, and is expected to provide the theoretical basis and thinking coordinates for the development of cultural markets and cultural industries.The main content of the course is economic logics underpinned cultural activities, such as cultural products, cultural business, cultural capital, cultural industries and cultural markets; on the other hand, cultural factors reflected and experienced by economic activities, as well as the value of thinking which plays an important role in economic activities.

description.zh: 培養學生認識與深入研究更多不同文化。
description.en: This course is designed to cultivate students’ understanding and deep research on more different cultures.

description.zh: 地質學是自然科學的一門，是研究地球這個人類所居住的星球自生成以來，組成的物質成分與結構之變化的科學。由於地質學主要是由現在所觀察得到的自然現象去推論現在地球中岩石的組成與結構，並用逆推 (Retrodiction) 的推論來解釋過去發生在地球之中的各種變化。因此野外觀察為地質學研究的最基本工作。在野外觀察時所用的方法與所依據的原則與理論，即是野外地質學學習的重點。本課程之內容除複習野外地質學與地質調查的一般觀念及基本原理，包括野外地質學導論，火成岩、沉積岩與變質岩地區的地質現象與地質調查的方法外，還將進一步建立區域地質圖測製的能力，以便未來能將地質調查的能力應用於各個相關領域。
description.en: Geologic fieldwork is the basic ability for all geological studies, whether they are simply intended to describe the rocks by various field methods, or whether they form the basis of interpretive studies based upon laboratory analysis of rock samples and geochemical and geophysical data collected in the field. Such data cannot be interpreted without detailed observations of the field relationships between collected samples and of the geology of areas in which measurements were made.Professer Tucker had said that "The study of field geology is often an exciting and rewarding occupation. However, to get the most out of these rocks, it is necessary to undertake precise and accurate fieldwork. The secret of successful fieldwork is a keen eye for detail and an enquiring mind. Be observant, see everything in the outcrop, then think about the things seen and look again."This course is designed as advanced training to field observation, description and geologic mapping for graduate student

description.zh: 本課程使學生具有進階德語能力，並加強聽說能力訓練。
description.en: The focus of this course is to enable students to enhance their German abilities and to strengthen the training or drilling of conversation and reading comprehension of the German language.

description.zh: 操作化學相關的實驗
description.en: It covers the fundamental experiments in chemistry.

description.zh: 本課程介紹各種分析材料表面性質的方法。藉著利用光子、電子、原子、或離子與材料表面的物理或化學作用，來獲得有關材料表面的組成、結構、化學鍵結、電子組態於表面形貌等訊息。所要介紹的表面分析儀器包括；X 光電子光譜儀 (XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀 (LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀 (STM)、表面振動光譜儀 (surface vibrational spectroscopy)、程式控溫脫附法 (TPD) 及真空技術。
description.en: The course introduces various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD.  From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

description.zh: 了解及熟悉各種布膜塗佈之技術, 每周實習以製作各種功能性布料為主. 布膜塗佈之技術包含 (1) 刮刀塗佈，(2) 輪式塗佈，及 (3) 熔融輪壓塗佈 (順塗，逆塗) 等。功能性布料種類則包含吸汗，透氣，撥水，保溫，抗起球等各種性質。
description.en: To introduce various coating techniques which include (1) knife coating (2) gravure coating (3) hot melt coating (co-rotating and counter rotation). The functions built in the fabric includes (1) water absorption (2) water repellence (3) cooling (4) warm protection (5) anti peeling… etc..

name.en: Practice on Fabric Coating and Finishing

description.zh: 本課程旨在對非工程類科出身之研究生，做有系統基礎材料科學之建立。課程包括 (1) 原子鍵結與配位 (2) 晶體 [原子規律性](3) 固相中之不規律性 (4) 相平衡 (5) 材料微結構 (6) 反應速率 (7) 材料破壞學 (8) 導電材與半導材料 (9) 陶瓷材料 (10) 聚合物及複合材料
description.en: This course is aimed at systematically introducing some important concepts of material engineering for students who were not an engineer training in their BS. The course covers (1)Atomic Bonding and Coordination (2)Crystal Structure (3)Disorder in Solid Phase (4)Phase Equilibria (5)Microstructures (6)Reaction Rate (7)Deformation and Fracture (8)Conducting and Semi-conducting Materials (9)Ceramic Materials (10)Polymer and Composites.

description.zh: 以國外設計競賽為主軸，輔導與協助學生積極的參與國外設計競賽，訓練學生獨立思考與問題解決能力。
description.en: This course aims to focus on domestic and international design competitions, guide and help students ' active, and let students have independent thinking and problem-solving skills.

description.zh: 本課程著重介紹電腦輔助製造技術的概念與實作。內容包括 NC 基本概念，一般機械零件之 NC 與 APT 程式製作，複雜曲面零件之 NC 程式製作，CAM 系統實習，群組技術電腦輔助製程規劃，電腦輔助製程規劃系統實習，電腦輔助生產規劃。
description.en: This course has been prepared for the comprehensive of Computer-aided manufacturing, with emphasis on the essentials of CNC technology and programming. Through the projects practice, the students are able to adept to the techniques of CAM.

description.zh: 1. 體認永續在設計之重要性 2. 熟悉永續之理論、知識、方法與應用 3. 解析綠色設計、生態環保、節能減碳 4. 綜合永續設計與工業設計實務
description.en: This course will assist in laying a basic foundation of knowledge for using 'sustainable design' assessment tools and rating schemes to inform the design process. The course will also enable students to engage in self-directed studies such as research and continuing development of professional careers.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在全球化環境下的專業英語溝通能力，整合科技、商業、社會及文化觀點。學生將探索新興科技、國際商業及數位經濟等關鍵議題，學習分析資訊並於多元專業環境中有效溝通。本課程強調理解這些領域，以提升在全球職場的專業能力。
description.en: This course develops professional English communication for a globalized world, integrating technology, business, social, and cultural perspectives. Students explore key topics like emerging technologies, international business, and digital economies, learning to analyze information and communicate effectively in diverse professional contexts. The course emphasizes understanding these areas to enhance global workplace proficiency.

name.en: Advanced English for Specific Purposes I

notes: A 組 - 學號尾號奇數，僅限英文系學生修讀，限 24 人

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生在商業及數據分析領域的英語能力，幫助學生能夠在國際化的商業環境中有效地進行交流、分析數據及撰寫報告。學生將學會如何用英文理解和表達商業概念、數據分析結果及相關的專業術語，並掌握在會議、報告、簡報和討論中使用英語的技巧。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance students' English proficiency in the fields of business and data analysis. It aims to help students effectively communicate, analyze data, and write reports in an international business environment. Students will learn how to understand and express business concepts, data analysis results, and related professional terminology in English. Additionally, they will develop skills for using English in meetings, reports, presentations, and discussions.

name.zh: 進階商業及數據英文 (一)
name.en: Advanced English for Business and Data Analysis I

notes: 僅限英文系學生修讀，限 27

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。
description.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

name.zh: 進階全球及永續議題英文 (一)
name.en: Advanced English for SDGs and Global Issues I

notes: 僅限英文系學生修讀，限 27

description.zh: 本課程內容主要分為兩大部分，首先介紹運輸系統的概念及運輸供需均衡理論，其次分別為對都市大眾運輸營運管理、大眾運輸行銷管理、鐵路運輸業經營管理、軌道運輸管理、都市副大眾運輸、都市機車管理、航空運輸、海運運輸、供應鏈與國際物流等七大系統之營運管理作有系統之介紹與探討。
description.en: This course consists of two parts. The first part introduces the basic concept of transportation systems and the theory for the transportation supply-demand equilibrium. The second part introduces and discusses the operational management of urban public transportation, marketing of public transportation, railway transportation, para-transit, motorcycle management, air transportation, maritime transportation, supply chain and global logistics.

notes: 工管四甲乙和工管四丙合開

description.zh: 本課程目標為幫助學生建立問題解決之能力。課程將首先介紹目前用於解決多目標決策問題的一些數量方法，之後說明各種多目標決策方法及其適用的問題類型。上課方式主要透過講解、問答、作業、報告及考試的方式提升學生學習的效果。課程主要介紹的方法有如下 AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Integral, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, Compromised Solutions 及 De Novo。經由此課程的學習，學生於期末時應該可以培養各種解決多目標決策問題的技能。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the problem-solving abilities. The course will begin from the introduction of different quantity methods in multi-criteria decision-making problems (MCDM). The categories of MCDM and their applicable problems are then presented. Students can learn different decision making tools through lectures, discussion, assignments, term-projects and examinations. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Integral, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, Compromised Solutions and the ideas of De Novo. At the end of the course, students should have the skills when they face MCDM problems.

description.zh: 本課程介紹終端人工智慧之實體技術與應用的核心概念與實務應用，聚焦於智慧系統如何透過感知、決策與行動與實體世界互動。課程內容涵蓋實體 AI 系統的重要基礎技術，包括機器學習感知模型、神經網路訓練、強化學習、模擬環境，以及系統整合等主題。並透過實作練習理解終端人工智慧於機器人、智慧裝置、自主系統等實體場域之實際應用建立對新興智慧實體技術發展趨勢的整體認識。
description.en: This course introduces the core concepts and practical applications of PhysicalTechnology and Edge AI, focusing on how intelligent systems interact with the physical world through perception, decision-making, and action. The course covers fundamental technologies of embodied AI systems, including machinelearning-based perception models, neural network training, reinforcement learning, simulation environments, and system integration. Through hands-on exercises, students will gain an understanding of the practical applications of Edge AI in physical domains such as robotics, smart devices, and autonomous systems, while developing a broad perspective on emerging trends in intelligent physical technologies.

name.zh: 終端人工智慧之實體技術與應用
name.en: Physical Technology and Application of Edge AI

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生運用資料分析技術解決實務問題之能力。課程內容涵蓋資料型態與資料前處理，包括資料蒐集、清理、整合、轉換與特徵工程等資料準備技術；並介紹常用之資料探勘方法，如分類（Classification）、分群（Clustering）、關聯分析與預測模型建構。課程亦結合大數據分析概念與實務應用，培養學生對大量、多樣與高速資料之分析能力。此外，課程將探討自然語言處理（NLP）與文字探勘技術，包括斷詞、詞頻分析、情感分析、主題模型與文本分類等方法，應用於社群媒體、評論資料及文件分析。透過案例實作與分析工具操作，提升學生在人工智慧與資料科學領域之實務應用與研究能力。
description.en: This course aims to develop students’ abilities to apply data analysis techniques to solve practical problems. The course covers data types and data preprocessing, including data collection, cleaning, integration, transformation,and feature engineering techniques for data preparation. It also introducescommonly used data mining methods, such as classification, clustering,association analysis, and predictive model construction. In addition, the course integrates big data analytics concepts with practical applications to cultivatestudents’ capabilities in analyzing large-scale, diverse, and high-velocity data.Furthermore, the course explores Natural Language Processing (NLP) and text mining techniques, including word segmentation, term frequency analysis, sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and text classification, with applications in social media, review data, and document analysis. Through case studies and hands-on analytical tool practices, students will enhance their practical

name.zh: 資料探勘與大數據分析
name.en: Data Mining and Big Data Analytics

description.zh: 本課程討論細胞培養與基因工程技術之原理與應用，課程內容包涵下列主題：(1) 微生物、植物、昆蟲及動物細胞之特性 (2) 細胞於生物反應器的培養，包括各式生物反應器介紹、生物反應器動力學、生物反應器之操作與控制 (3) 基因重組蛋白之表現，將包涵不同的細胞載体表現系統 (4) 實例探討，如單株抗體、生物高分子材料、基因治療載体等之生產。
description.en: This course discusses the principle and applications of cell culture and molecular biology.  The course covers the following topics: (1) characteristics of microbial, plant, insect, and mammalian cells; (2) cell culture in bioreactors, including descriptions of bioreactor types, operation modes, bioreactor kinetics, and instrumentation and control; (3) expression of foreign genes in various cell systems; (4) case studies, such as production of monoclonal antibody, biopolymers, and gene therapy vectors.

name.en: Special Topics in Molecular Cell Biology

description.zh: 本課程係探討纖維製品在非衣著終端領域之應用，例如電子電機，土木，材料，生醫，航空與車輛工程等之應用。其內容包括功能性與機能性纖維、複合紗、複合織物、編帶、非織物、纖維系複合材料與電線電纜、光纖電纜等之製造方法、原理與其終端應用領域。最後將討論微細加工技術與微細粉末在纖維與高科技工業上之應用。
description.en: The course is to interpret the application of the non-apparel textiles at the different end uses, such as application in electrical and electronic, civil, material, biomedical, aerospace, and vehicle engineering etc.  It includes fabrication methods, principles, and end application fields of the performance and functional fibers, composite yarns, composite fabrics, braid, nonwoven, textile composites, and cables and optical cables etc.　Finally, the micro processing technology and powder in textile and high-tech industries will be discussed.

description.en: The aim of the course is to introduce various spectroscopic methods to identify structure of organic compounds. It includes：UV spectroscopy, IR spectroscopy, NMR spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, Atomic  spectroscopy, Mass spectroscopy, X-ray methods, Potentiometric  methods, and Thermal methods.

description.zh: 文化創意產業含蓋甚廣，不僅僅包含了人文、藝術，甚至在族群文化振興、媒體研究、博物館經營與藝術管理、大眾消費、設計等領域都被重視。也因為文化創意是一塊值得投資的領域，更誘引這些族群的工作者紛紛投入與文化創意產業結合的工作。而本課程將全程使用英文來授課，也可藉由閱讀國內外文化創意相關文章，培養學生的英文閱讀、聽、說、與寫作能力，進而培養更多元的國際觀。
description.en: Covering a wide cultural and creative industry, the cultural vocation development not only includes the humanities, arts, and even has been valued at ethnic culture promotion; media studies, museum management and arts management, marketing, design, and other related these fields. Because of the cultural and creative field is a worthwhile investment; this reason inspires workers that have invested in these communities, cultural, and creative industries combined work. And through this course will be taught in English, but also by learning the foreign cultural related the cultural articles, students can practice English reading, listening, speaking, and writing skills, and to cultivate more diversified international views.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探究投資者如何安排與管理各類金融資產，透過本課程期使學生瞭解投資基本理論、投資工具與運用、投資分析與策略、金融證券市場實務操作以及投資未來的新趨勢，給予學生正確的投資觀念。課程內容包括投資學背景架構、報酬與投資組合理論等等。站在投資者的角度，結合投資理論與學術實證結果之討論，將投資的基本理論與觀念，讓學生理解在市場與投資決策上之實用性，並培養獨立思考與辯證能力。
description.en: This course is to interpret the economic analysis and evaluation of investment. The main topics include investment models, investment criteria, investment risk analysis, investment decision under uncertainty.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

notes: 光電四、光電所選修和太空所必修合開、億光 405 教

description.zh: 衛星科技與工程導論的課程將介紹衛星系統及次系統基礎知識，以培養具有從事衛星任務設計之基礎能力。課程內容包括：衛星基本原理，衛星設計與製造，衛星運行與維護，衛星通訊與遙測應用，衛星發展趨勢。
description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

name.en: Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering

notes: 光電四、光電所選修和太空所必修合開、億光 405 教

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

name.zh: 深度學習與太空科技應用

notes: 光電四、光電所選修和太空所必修合開、億光 405 教

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹資料探勘與大數據分析的理論方法與應用，課程內容涵蓋資料探勘的基本概念，如資料準備、資料探勘的方法與實證、資料探勘的進一步運用，並加入商業等各領域的實務案例介紹，具體說明如何應用資料探勘與大數據分析技術以解決真實問題。 另外在工具方面則透過相關分析軟體操作與實作範例輔以說明，讓學生學習資料的準備、工具的應用及分析判斷，透過實作課程，使學生能容易應用資料探勘方法，進而提升大數據分析和數位決策能力。
description.en: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for the efficiency of decision making in various fields. The topics are about basic concepts of data manipulations, analytic, and communications which are including: introduction to big data; basic knowledge of data mining; special topics of big data in business Analytics, and data analytic project. The course will help students careful consideration of what is desired from big data, how big data analytic to add value to business, etc. Students can gain a strong data science knowledge set and techniques via in-depth case studies, most current readings and experiences, and most current and future technology exploration.

notes: 資財所和 IMBA 合開

description.zh: 本課程探討的內容涵蓋國際金融基本觀念、架構、理論與應用，課程內容包括：匯率、外匯市場 (即期、遠期、外匯期貨和外匯選擇權市場)、國際收支與國際貨幣制度、國際收支調整理論和均衡匯率決定理論等。同時討論國際金融環境的變化、多國籍企業如何規避匯率風險、開放經濟下的總體經濟政策等議題。此門課的修習除了有助於了解國際金融相關知識外，並可以培養對國際金融與匯兌問題之思考、探討、批判與洞察能力。
description.en: This course provides the introduction to the workings of the foreign exchange markets, the impact of economic policy on exchange rates, the nature of foreign exchange risk, and the effects of various international economic policies on domestic and world welfare. The course content will include balance of payments, determination of foreign exchange rates, and international monetary system, and cover the following topics: foreign exchange market; the interest rate parity theorem; exchange rates and inflation; purchasing power parity; balance of payments and national income accounting; the determination of the exchange rate.  In addition, we focus on how multinational corporations manage their exchange rate risk, and how they make sound investment and financing decisions factoring exchange rate fluctuations.

description.zh: 專題討論本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解有機材料之最新開發成品或最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the organic materials. Speakers being invited are well-known scholars in organic area.  Graduate students or thesis advisors will also be invited to report any in interesting result from their graduate studies.

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目, 在教授個別指導下, 進行實驗之研究, 以培養學生尋找相關資料, 文獻及獨立研究的訓練, 並將其研究成果撰寫成博士論文及發表於國際期刊。
description.en: To make students able to carry out independent study in master level. Students will be assigned a research topic. An independent experimental design, data analysis, doctoral thesis writing, and paper publication are necessary for this course.

description.zh: 本課程除了講授如何使用 Westlaw International 資料庫進行智財之研究外，主要著重於介紹商標法、著作權法研究文獻之檢索。特別在課堂上，授課教師將教授學生如何做關於商標法、著作權法之研究，以及如何撰寫有關商標法、著作權法之研究論文。學生之課堂參與是必須的，至於其他課程資訊請見中英文課程摘要。
description.en: This course is not only intended to teach students how to use Westlaw International database for studying IP issues, but also it primarily teaches students to introduce searching of research materials about Trademark Law & Copyright Law. In particularly, teachers will teach students how to conduct Trademark Law & Copyright Law researches. Students will know how to write research articles regarding Trademark Law & Copyright Law. Students are required to attend class, and all other class information are seen in Chinese and English class syllabus.

description.zh: 本科目旨在探討人們的選擇行為，亦即如何利用有限的資源，以滿足人類無限的慾望。個體經濟學著眼於價格機能之方析，範圍涵蓋：消費者行為、廠商理論、各種市場的結構分析、以及公共部門的決策。
description.en: Economics explores choice behavior of human beings. Especially, it concerns how people make choice in order to satisfy their unlimited desire under limited resources. Microeconomics focuses on the analysis of price mechanism which involves consumer behavior, firms' decision making, structure of various markets, and public sector.

description.zh: 中文概述：專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case study. Seminar. Group meeting.

description.zh: 本課程希望讓學生了解如何正確選擇與使用多變項統計方法，並能閱讀、呈現與解釋多變項統計報告或結果。課程包括因子設計、實驗設計、共變數分析、複迴歸等主題，以探討教育研究中多重且同時的影響因素。
description.en: This curriculum lets students understand how to choose and use multi-variance statistics methods exactly.  It also includes that reading, presenting and explaining the report or result of multi-variance statistics analysis exactly.  The topics of the curriculum include that factor design, experimental design, covariance analysis, and multi-regression, al etc. to explore the influence of multi and simultaneous factors in the educational research.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.
